account.keys_changed.finishing.text: Your account has new keys. We are finishing the change.
account.keys_changed.finishing.comment: Shown after a reset or take-back while the last steps are still owed, for an account that has no saved recovery phrase. Must not mention words or a phrase.

app.not_found.body.text: There is nothing at this address.
app.not_found.body.comment: Line under 'Page not found' on the web page shown for an unknown address.

app.not_found.title.comment: Heading of the web page shown for an address the app does not know.

app.update.ready.text: A new version of Lakko is ready.
app.update.ready.comment: Web banner shown when a newer version of the web app has been downloaded and a reload will start it.

app.update.reload.comment: Button on the web update banner that reloads the page to start the new version.

app.update.reloading.comment: Update banner button while the page is reloading.

auth.brand.body.text: Chats, groups, channels and calls, end-to-end encrypted by default.
auth.brand.body.comment: Text under the headline on the brand panel beside the sign-in and sign-up forms.

auth.brand.foot.text: Open source. No phone number required.
auth.brand.foot.comment: Small line at the bottom of the brand panel.

auth.brand.tagline.comment: Headline on the brand panel beside the sign-in and sign-up forms.

auth.error.wrong_credentials.text: Wrong username or password. Check them and try again.
auth.error.wrong_credentials.comment: Sign-in failed. Deliberately does not say which of the two was wrong, so nobody can find out which usernames exist.

auth.explainer.never_leaves.text: Your password never leaves your device. Lakko checks it without ever receiving it, so nobody at Lakko can read it, and nobody can reset it for you.
auth.explainer.never_leaves.comment: First paragraph of the password explanation.

auth.explainer.same_answer.text: A wrong username and a wrong password get the same answer, so nobody can use the login screen to find out which usernames exist.
auth.explainer.same_answer.comment: Second paragraph of the password explanation.

auth.explainer.title.comment: Link that expands an explanation of how the password is protected.

auth.explainer.ways_back.text: If you forget it, you can get back in with another device that is still logged in, a passkey, your recovery phrase, three words from it, or an authenticator app.
auth.explainer.ways_back.comment: Third paragraph of the password explanation: the ways back into an account (another device, a passkey, the recovery phrase, three words of it, an authenticator app).

auth.key_store_unavailable.body.text: Your system keyring isn't available. Unlock it or install one, then try again.
auth.key_store_unavailable.body.comment: Body of the desktop key-store refusal screen; the button under it (common.try_again) repeats the step that failed.

auth.key_store_unavailable.title.text: Lakko can't store your keys safely on this computer.
auth.key_store_unavailable.title.comment: Title of the desktop screen shown when the operating system's key store (Keychain, Windows key store, Linux keyring) is missing or refused. Sign-in stops here.

auth.language.button.comment: Accessibility label of the globe button on the sign-in and sign-up screens.

auth.login.forgot.comment: Link from the sign-in screen to the recovery screen.

auth.login.no_account.comment: Line under the sign-in form; {link} is the 'Create account' link.

auth.login.passkey.comment: Button that signs in with a passkey instead of the password.

auth.login.submit.comment: Sign-in button, and the link to the sign-in screen from other auth screens.

auth.login.submitting.comment: Busy label of the sign-in button.

auth.passkey.error.cancelled.comment: The person closed the passkey prompt.

auth.passkey.error.failed_status.comment: Passkey sign-in failed; {status} is an HTTP status number, keep it in Latin digits.

auth.passkey.error.generic.text: Could not sign in with the passkey. Try again, or use your password.
auth.passkey.error.generic.comment: Passkey sign-in failed for a reason with no more specific message.

auth.passkey.error.network.comment: The connection failed during passkey sign-in.

auth.passkey.error.not_registered.text: No passkey is registered for this account. Sign in with password first, then add a passkey from Home.
auth.passkey.error.not_registered.comment: No passkey exists for the account.

auth.passkey.error.server_disabled.comment: The server has passkeys switched off.

auth.passkey.error.unsupported.comment: Passkeys are not available in this browser.

auth.passkey.error.wrong_account.text: This passkey belongs to a different account than the one on this device. Log in with your password first.
auth.passkey.error.wrong_account.comment: Passkey sign-in refused: the passkey chosen is for another account than the one saved on this device.

auth.password.confirm.label.comment: Label of the second password field on the sign-up form.

auth.password.error.mismatch.text: The passwords do not match. Type the same password twice.

auth.password.error.too_short.text: Use at least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
auth.password.error.too_short.comment: The new password is too short; {count} is the minimum length.

auth.password.hide.comment: Accessibility label of the button that hides the typed password again.

auth.password.hint.text: At least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
auth.password.hint.comment: Helper text under a password field that sets a new password, before anything is typed.

auth.password.new.label.comment: Label of the new password field on the recovery forms.

auth.password.new_confirm.label.comment: Label of the second new-password field on the recovery forms.

auth.password.show.comment: Accessibility label of the button that reveals the typed password.

auth.signup.error.fix_name.comment: Sign-up submitted with a profile name that is not allowed.

auth.signup.error.generic.text: Could not create the account. Try again.
auth.signup.error.generic.comment: Sign-up failed for a reason with no more specific message.

auth.signup.error.rate_limited.text: Too many new accounts from this network right now. Try again later.
auth.signup.error.rate_limited.comment: The server limits new accounts per network.

auth.signup.error.username_taken.text: That username is taken. Choose another one.
auth.signup.error.username_taken.comment: The chosen username belongs to someone else.

auth.signup.have_account.comment: Line under the sign-up form; {link} is the 'Log in' link.

auth.signup.lede.text: Your password never leaves your device. You will get a recovery phrase to write down next.

auth.signup.name.hint.text: Shown to your contacts. Leave it empty to show your username.
auth.signup.name.hint.comment: Helper text under the optional name field on the sign-up form.

auth.signup.name.label.comment: Label of the optional profile name field on the sign-up form.

auth.signup.passkey.add.comment: Primary button of the passkey step at the end of signup.

auth.signup.passkey.default_name.comment: Name given to the passkey added at the end of signup; shown later in the list of passkeys, where it can be told apart from others.

auth.signup.passkey.error.text: Could not add the passkey. Try again, or choose Not now.
auth.signup.passkey.error.comment: Adding a passkey at the end of signup failed. 'Not now' is the button that skips the step.

auth.signup.passkey.lede.text: Add a passkey so you can log in with your face, fingerprint or screen lock.
auth.signup.passkey.lede.comment: Line under 'Add a passkey' at the end of signup.

auth.signup.passkey.title.comment: Title of the last signup step, which offers to add a passkey.

auth.signup.submit.comment: Sign-up button, and the link to the sign-up screen from the sign-in screen.

auth.signup.username.hint.text: Latin letters, digits and _. Others find you by this name.
auth.signup.username.hint.comment: Helper text under the username field on the sign-up form, shown while the name is fine.

auth.signup.working.line.text: This takes a little while, once. You will not wait like this again.
auth.signup.working.line.comment: Line under the busy row while an account is created.

auth.signup.working.title.comment: Busy row while the account is created; this takes a while once.

auth.username.label.comment: Label of the username field on the sign-in, sign-up and recovery forms.

backup.rollback_refused.body.text: The server returned an altered or outdated backup. Your account is safe; we continued without restoring the older data.
backup.rollback_refused.body.comment: Body of the alert shown when a restore refused a backup the server returned rolled back or altered (ADR-0037). Nothing older was loaded.

backup.rollback_refused.title.text: Backup could not be restored safely
backup.rollback_refused.title.comment: Title of the alert shown when a restore refused a rolled-back or altered backup from the server.

backup.stale_restore.body.text: This backup is older than expected ({reason}). {consequence}
backup.stale_restore.body.comment: Dialog body; {reason} says why it was judged old (e.g. how long ago it was signed); {consequence} is the consequence sentence, passed already translated.

backup.stale_restore.confirm.comment: Destructive button: proceeds past the warning.

backup.stale_restore.consequence.text: Restoring it brings back an older contact list and older settings. Changes you made to them since will be missing.
backup.stale_restore.consequence.comment: What restoring an older backup does. The backup holds contacts and settings only (no messages, no devices), so the consequence is limited to those.

backup.stale_restore.reason.anchor_unrea.text: this device's record of your last backup is unreadable or was tampered with
backup.stale_restore.reason.anchor_unrea.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the local record of the last backup could not be read.

backup.stale_restore.reason.below_floor.text: older than the last backup restored on this device
backup.stale_restore.reason.below_floor.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the backup is older than one this device already restored.

backup.stale_restore.reason.head_strippe.text: its signature was removed and it differs from the last backup this device knew
backup.stale_restore.reason.head_strippe.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the backup came without its signed header and does not match the last known backup.

backup.stale_restore.reason.too_old.text: it was signed longer ago than a current backup would be
backup.stale_restore.reason.too_old.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: on a new device, the backup's signature is older than the allowed window.

backup.stale_restore.title.comment: Confirmation dialog title when the backup found is older than the newest one this account has made (a possible rollback).

call.alert.title.comment: Title of the alert that explains why a call did not start or ended (the message under it says why).

call.bar.camera_on_a11y.comment: Added to what the screen reader says for the call bar while your camera is sending; joined into a list.

call.bar.encrypted_a11y.comment: Added to what the screen reader says for the call bar when the call is end-to-end encrypted; joined into a list after the call's state.

call.bar.region_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the bar at the top of the app that holds a call which was put away.

call.bar.return_a11y.comment: Start of what the screen reader says for the call bar; {name} is who the call is with (or the group-call label). The call's state follows, joined as a list.

call.busy.call_join.text: You are already in a call. End it before you join another one.
call.busy.call_join.comment: Joining a call was refused because a one-to-one call is already going on.

call.busy.call_start.text: You are already in a call. End it before you start another one.
call.busy.call_start.comment: A new call was refused because a one-to-one call is already going on.

call.busy.group_join.text: You are already in a group call. End it before you join another one.
call.busy.group_join.comment: Joining a call was refused because a group call is already going on.

call.busy.group_start.text: You are already in a group call. End it before you start another one.
call.busy.group_start.comment: A new call was refused because a group call is already going on.

call.busy.link_join.text: You are already in a call from a link. End it before you join another one.
call.busy.link_join.comment: Joining a call was refused because a call opened from a link is already going on.

call.busy.link_start.text: You are already in a call from a link. End it before you start another one.
call.busy.link_start.comment: A new call was refused because a call opened from a link is already going on.

call.camera_failed.not_allowed.text: Lakko was not allowed to use the camera. The call continues without it.
call.camera_failed.not_allowed.comment: Shown in a call when turning the camera on failed because permission was refused.

call.camera_failed.not_found.text: No camera was found. The call continues without it.
call.camera_failed.not_found.comment: Shown in a call when turning the camera on failed because there is no camera.

call.camera_failed.other.text: The camera could not be started. It may be in use by another app.
call.camera_failed.other.comment: Shown in a call when turning the camera on failed for another reason.

call.capture.both.failed.text: The microphone and camera could not be started. You can listen and watch.
call.capture.both.failed.comment: Shown in a group call when neither the microphone nor the camera could start; the person can still hear and see the others.

call.capture.both.not_allowed.text: Lakko was not allowed to use the microphone or camera. You can listen and watch.
call.capture.both.not_allowed.comment: Shown in a group call when microphone and camera permission were refused; the person can still hear and see the others.

call.capture.both.not_found.text: No microphone or camera was found. You can listen and watch.
call.capture.both.not_found.comment: Shown in a group call when this device has neither a microphone nor a camera; the person can still hear and see the others.

call.capture.camera.failed.text: The camera could not be started. You joined with your microphone.
call.capture.camera.failed.comment: Shown in a group call joined with video when the camera failed to start.

call.capture.camera.not_allowed.text: Lakko was not allowed to use the camera. You joined with your microphone.
call.capture.camera.not_allowed.comment: Shown in a group call joined with video when camera permission was refused.

call.capture.camera.not_found.text: No camera was found. You joined with your microphone.
call.capture.camera.not_found.comment: Shown in a group call joined with video when this device has no camera.

call.chat.a11y.comment: Accessible name of the chat panel inside a group call.

call.chat.close_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the button that closes the chat panel inside a group call.

call.chat.empty.text: No messages yet. Messages here are end-to-end encrypted.
call.chat.empty.comment: Empty state of the chat panel inside a group call.

call.chat.joined.comment: Line in the call's chat when someone joins; {name} is the person.

call.chat.left.comment: Line in the call's chat when someone leaves.

call.collapse_a11y.text: Put the call away and return to the app
call.collapse_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the chevron that shrinks the call screen into the call bar without ending the call.

call.collapse_title.comment: Tooltip of the chevron that shrinks the call screen into the call bar without ending the call.

call.control.bar_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the row of in-call buttons.

call.control.camera.comment: Label under the in-call camera button.

call.control.camera_start_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the in-call camera button while the camera is off.

call.control.camera_stop_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the in-call camera button while the camera is on.

call.control.chat.comment: Label under the group-call button that opens the call's chat; also the chat panel's heading.

call.control.chat_hide_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the group-call button that closes the call's chat.

call.control.chat_show_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the group-call button that opens the call's chat.

call.control.chat_unread.comment: Group call menu item that opens the call's chat, when messages are unread. {count} is the number of unread messages.

call.control.end.comment: Label under the red in-call button that ends the call.

call.control.end_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the red in-call button that ends the call.

call.control.invite.comment: Label under the in-call button that hands out a link to the call.

call.control.invite_a11y.text: Invite someone to this call with a link
call.control.invite_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the in-call Invite button.

call.control.lower_hand.comment: Group call menu item that lowers the hand you raised.

call.control.more.comment: Short word under the round button that opens a group call's menu (participants, chat, settings). One word; it names the action.

call.control.more_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the button that opens a group call's menu.

call.control.mute.comment: Label under the in-call microphone button. It names the device, like Camera, and does not change when the microphone is muted.

call.control.mute_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the in-call microphone button while the microphone is on.

call.control.participants.comment: Label under the group-call button for the people in the call (their list and, on a call with a link, the ways to invite); also the list's heading, its accessible name and the menu item that opens it.

call.control.participants_hide_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the group-call button that closes the list of people in the call.

call.control.participants_menu_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the group-call Participants button when it opens a menu with the list of participants and the two ways to invite someone.

call.control.participants_show_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the group-call button that opens the list of people in the call.

call.control.raise_hand.comment: Group call menu item that raises your hand so the others see you want to speak.

call.control.settings.comment: Label under the in-call button that opens the call settings: which microphone, camera and speaker to use.

call.control.share_screen.comment: Group call menu item that starts showing your screen to the call.

call.control.speaker.comment: Label under the in-call button that moves the call's sound to the next speaker.

call.control.speaker_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the in-call Speaker button; {device} is the speaker it switches to (its own name, or the words of call.control.speaker_default_device / call.control.speaker_next_device).

call.control.speaker_default_device.comment: Fills {device} in call.control.speaker_a11y when the system's default speaker has no name.

call.control.speaker_next_device.comment: Fills {device} in call.control.speaker_a11y when the next speaker has no name.

call.control.speaker_off_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the speaker button while the loudspeaker is on.

call.control.speaker_on_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the speaker button while the loudspeaker is off (sound through the earpiece).

call.control.stop_share_screen.comment: Group call menu item that stops showing your screen.

call.control.unmute_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the in-call microphone button while the microphone is muted.

call.e2ee.comment: Line with a lock on the incoming-call screen and the group-call banner: the call is end-to-end encrypted.

call.encryption.chip.comment: Chip on the call screen saying the call is end-to-end encrypted; pressing it shows the safety number.

call.encryption.chip_a11y.text: This call is encrypted. Show the safety number
call.encryption.chip_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the Encrypted chip on the call screen.

call.encryption.compare_hint.text: Read these numbers aloud. If they match on both phones, no one is listening.
call.encryption.compare_hint.comment: Under the call's safety number: how to compare it with the other person.

call.encryption.copy_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the Copy button in the call encryption sheet.

call.encryption.number_a11y.comment: Spoken by the screen reader for the call's safety number; {groups} is the four-digit groups in order, already joined as a list.

call.encryption.number_unavailable.comment: Spoken by the screen reader when the call has no safety number to show.

call.encryption.sentence_group.text: Only the people on this call can hear it.
call.encryption.sentence_group.comment: The safety-number sheet's sentence in a group call, or when the other person has no name on this device.

call.encryption.sentence_named.text: Only you and {name} can hear this call.
call.encryption.sentence_named.comment: The safety-number sheet's sentence in a one-to-one call; {name} is the other person.

call.encryption.setting_up.comment: Shown in place of the Encrypted chip on the call screen while the call's end-to-end encryption is not yet in place. Must never claim the call is protected.

call.encryption.title.comment: Title of the sheet that shows the call's safety number.

call.end_menu.a11y.comment: Spoken name of the small menu the End button opens for the person who started a group call.

call.end_menu.end_for_all.comment: Row in the menu the End button opens for the person who started a group call: ends the call for every person in it.

call.end_menu.leave.comment: Row in the menu the End button opens for the person who started a group call: this person leaves and the call goes on for the others.

call.ended.for_all.text: The call was ended for everyone
call.ended.for_all.comment: Line on the ended-call screen when the person who started the call ended it for everyone and the device cannot name that person.

call.ended.for_all_by.comment: Line on the ended-call screen when the person who started the call ended it for everyone; {name} is that person's name.

call.error.encryption_setup.text: Could not set up call encryption, so the call did not start.
call.error.encryption_setup.comment: Shown when the device could not derive the call's encryption key; the call is refused rather than started unencrypted.

call.error.join_group.text: Could not join the group call. Try again.
call.error.join_group.comment: Joining a group call failed and no more specific reason is known.

call.error.microphone_not_allowed.text: Lakko was not allowed to use the microphone.
call.error.microphone_not_allowed.comment: A call could not start because microphone permission was refused.

call.error.microphone_not_found.comment: A call could not start because this device has no microphone.

call.error.no_media_encryption.text: This browser cannot encrypt call media, so the call did not start.
call.error.no_media_encryption.comment: A group call or a call from a link was refused because this browser cannot end-to-end encrypt call audio and video; Lakko never falls back to an unencrypted call.

call.error.not_accepting.text: This call is not accepting new participants right now.
call.error.not_accepting.comment: Joining a call was refused because too many new accounts joined it in a short time.

call.error.not_member.text: You are no longer a member of this chat.
call.error.not_member.comment: A group call in a chat could not be started or joined because this person is no longer in the chat.

call.error.signed_out_start.text: You are signed out. Sign in again to start a call.
call.error.signed_out_start.comment: The New call button on the Calls screen was pressed without a signed-in session.

call.error.start_group.text: Could not start the group call. Try again.
call.error.start_group.comment: Starting a group call failed and no more specific reason is known.

call.error.unavailable.text: Calls are not available right now. Try again later.
call.error.unavailable.comment: A call could not start because the call service is not reachable or not set up.

call.fill.remote_camera_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the other person's video filling the call screen; {name} is who the call is with.

call.grid.next_a11y.comment: Button on a group call's grid: go to the next page of people.

call.grid.page_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of one page dot of a group call's grid; {page} and {total} are numbers.

call.grid.prev_a11y.comment: Button on a group call's grid: go to the previous page of people.

call.group_banner.join_video.comment: Button on the group call banner that joins the call with the camera on.

call.group_banner.open_chat.comment: Button on the group call banner that opens the chat the call is in.

call.group_banner.title.comment: Banner shown on any screen while a group call is going on in a chat that is not open; {name} is the chat.

call.guest.default_name.comment: Fallback name prefilled for a visitor without an account who joins a call from a link, used only when the generated adjective-and-animal name is unavailable; it becomes the new account's profile name.

call.guest.note.text: You join as a guest. No account is needed.
call.guest.note.comment: Line under the Join button on a call-link page, shown to a visitor without an account.

call.guest.working.title.comment: Busy row while a guest account is created to join a call from a link.

call.history.call_back_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the call-back button at the end of a row in the call history.

call.history.call_back_video_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the call-back button on a row for a video call in the call history.

call.history.empty.comment: Empty state of the Calls screen.

call.history.empty_body.text: Calls you make and receive appear here.
call.history.empty_body.comment: Second line of the empty call history, under 'No calls yet'.

call.history.join_by_link.comment: Button on the Calls screen that opens a field to paste a call link.

call.history.join_invalid.text: That does not look like a call link. Paste the whole link and try again.
call.history.join_invalid.comment: Error under the call-link field on the Calls screen when the text is not a call link.

call.history.new_call.comment: Button on the Calls screen that starts a new group video call.

call.history.paste_hint.text: The person who created the call shares the link.
call.history.paste_hint.comment: Hint under the field where a call link is pasted to join a call.

call.history.paste_label.comment: Label of the field on the Calls screen where a call link is pasted.

call.history.unknown_conversation.comment: Name of a call history row whose conversation is no longer on this device.

call.incoming.accept.comment: Button that answers an incoming call.

call.incoming.accept_from.comment: Accessible name of the button that answers a call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.accept_video_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the button that answers a video call with the camera on; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.accept_voice_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the button that answers a voice call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.accept_without_video.comment: Button that answers an incoming video call with the camera off.

call.incoming.accept_without_video_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the button that answers an incoming video call with the camera off; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.decline.comment: Button that declines an incoming call.

call.incoming.decline_from.comment: Accessible name of the button that declines a call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.decline_video_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the button that declines a video call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.decline_voice_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the button that declines a voice call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.video_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the full-screen incoming video call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.incoming.voice_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the full-screen incoming voice call; {name} is the caller or conversation.

call.invite.copied.text: Link copied. Anyone you send it to can ask to join.
call.invite.copied.comment: Line on the call screen after the link to the call was copied.

call.invite.link_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the call link shown in the Invite panel of a call.

call.invite.menu_a11y.comment: Screen reader label of the menu the Invite button of a call opens.

call.invite.menu_contact.comment: Menu item on the call screen: choose one or more conversations and send each an invitation to this call.

call.invite.menu_copy.comment: Menu item on the call screen: copy the link to this call.

call.invite.minting.text: Preparing a link to this call. This takes a few seconds.
call.invite.minting.comment: Line on the call screen while a link to the call is being prepared.

call.invite.picker_empty.text: No contacts yet. Copy the invite link and send it another way.
call.invite.picker_empty.comment: Shown in the 'Invite to call' list when the person has no contacts to invite.

call.invite.picker_title.comment: Title of the list of conversations shown when inviting a contact to a call.

call.invite.ready.text: Anyone with this link can ask to join this call. You decide who comes in.

chat.members.unapplied.transfer_line.comment: Under a person you asked to hand the group's ownership to; the transfer did not apply.

chat.members.unnamed.comment: Name shown for a group member who has published no name and is not a contact.

chat.message.actions.comment: Accessible name of the menu that opens on a message.

chat.message.close_actions.comment: Screen-reader label of the dimmed area around the message action menu; tapping it closes the menu.

chat.message.deleted.comment: Placeholder shown in place of a message its author deleted, in the timeline and as the chat list preview.

chat.message.edit.comment: Message menu item: change the text of the reader's own message.

chat.message.edited.comment: Marker after the text of a message its author changed.

chat.message.forward.comment: Message menu item and selection-bar button: send the message to another conversation.

chat.message.media_fallback.comment: Screen reader name of a selectable message that has attachments and no text.

chat.message.more_reactions.comment: Button in the message menu that opens the full emoji picker for reacting.

chat.message.not_sent.comment: In place of the time under the reader's message when it could not be sent.

chat.message.pin.comment: Message menu item: pin the message.

chat.message.react.comment: Accessible name of the row of reaction emoji at the top of the message menu.

chat.message.react_with.comment: Accessible name of one reaction button; {emoji} is the emoji itself.

chat.message.read.comment: Tooltip of the double check under the reader's message: everyone else has read it.

chat.message.read_by.comment: Tooltip of the double check under the reader's message; {names} lists who read it.

chat.message.reply.comment: Message menu item: answer this message with a quote of it.

chat.message.save.comment: Message menu row under Pin: add the message to the account's saved list.

chat.message.saved_mark.comment: Accessibility label of the small mark beside the time of a saved message.

chat.message.select.comment: Message menu item: start selecting several messages, this one first.

chat.message.sending.comment: In place of the time under the reader's message while it is being sent.

chat.message.sent.comment: Tooltip of the single check under the reader's message: sent, not yet read by everyone.

chat.message.unpin.comment: Message menu item: remove the pin from the message.

chat.message.unsave.comment: Message menu row on a saved message; also the long-press action on a Saved screen row.

chat.message.unsupported.text: This message needs a newer version of Lakko.
chat.message.unsupported.comment: Shown in place of a message the sender's newer app wrote in a format this version cannot read: in the timeline, as the chat list preview and as the notification body.

chat.not_found.back.comment: Link back to the conversation list.

chat.not_found.body.text: This link does not match a conversation on this device.
chat.not_found.body.comment: Body of the page shown for a link to a conversation this device does not have.

chat.not_found.title.comment: Title of the page shown for a link to a conversation this device does not have.

chat.peer.fallback_name.comment: Name shown for the other person in a one-to-one chat when nothing better is known.

chat.pending.call_disabled.comment: Tooltip or long-press hint of the disabled call buttons in a chat whose other side has not answered yet.

chat.pending.stale.text: {name} has not answered yet. You can ask them for a new link.

chat.pending.waiting.text: {name} will get your messages when their app is next online.

chat.photo.load_failed.comment: Shown over a photo that failed to load.

chat.photo.load_failed_retry.comment: Accessible name of a photo in a message that failed to load; activating it retries. Used on web, iOS and Android, so it must not say tap or click.

chat.photo.loading.comment: Accessible name of a photo in a message while it loads.

chat.photo.open.comment: Screen-reader action of a photo in a message: opens it full screen.

chat.photo.viewer.comment: Screen-reader label of the full-screen photo viewer.

chat.photo.viewer_hint.text: Pinch to zoom. Swipe down to close.
chat.photo.viewer_hint.comment: Screen reader hint on a photo opened full screen.

chat.pin.detail_personal.comment: Line under the option that pins a message for the reader only: nobody else sees the pin.

chat.pin.detail_shared.comment: Line under the option that pins a message for everyone in the conversation.

chat.pin.for_both.comment: Option in a one-to-one chat: pin the message for both people.

chat.pin.for_everyone.comment: Option in a group: pin the message for every member.

chat.pin.for_me.comment: Option: pin the message for the reader only.

chat.pin.sheet_title.comment: Title of the sheet asking whether to pin a message for the reader only or for everyone.

chat.pinned_bar.all.comment: Button on the pinned-message bar that opens the list of every pinned message.

chat.pinned_bar.for_you.comment: Shown in the pinned-message bar in place of the author, when the pin is the reader's own personal pin.

chat.pinned_bar.hint.comment: Screen reader hint on the pinned message bar: tapping scrolls to the pinned message.

chat.pinned_bar.label.comment: Accessible name of the bar above the timeline that shows a pinned message.

chat.pinned_bar.label_of.comment: Accessible name of the pinned-message bar when several messages are pinned; {index} is which one is shown.

chat.pinned_bar.list_title.comment: Title of the list of every pinned message in the conversation.

chat.reaction.add_title.comment: Tooltip of a reaction someone else made: tapping adds the reader's; {names} lists who reacted.

chat.reaction.reacted_by.comment: Tooltip of a reaction under a message; {names} lists who reacted with this emoji.

chat.reaction.reacted_by_title.comment: Heading of the list of people who reacted with an emoji, opened by a long press on a reaction.

chat.reaction.remove_title.comment: Tooltip of a reaction the reader made: tapping removes it; {names} lists who reacted.

chat.reaction.single_emoji.text: A reaction must be a single emoji.
chat.reaction.single_emoji.comment: The reader tried to react with something that is not exactly one emoji.

chat.reauth.action.comment: Button that signs out and returns to sign-in.

chat.reauth.body.text: The keys needed to decrypt and sign messages are not available in this session. Sign in again to open this chat.
chat.reauth.body.comment: Body of the page shown when this session cannot open a chat without signing in again.

chat.reauth.title.comment: Title of the page shown when this session cannot open a chat without signing in again.

chat.record.bar_video.comment: Accessible name of the recording bar while a round video message is recorded.

chat.record.bar_voice.comment: Accessible name of the recording bar that replaces the message field.

chat.record.cancelled.comment: Short notice after a recording was cancelled.

chat.record.delete.comment: Accessible name of the button that throws away the recording.

chat.record.denied_camera.text: Lakko needs camera access to record video messages. Allow camera access in your browser's site settings.

chat.record.denied_camera_app.comment: Card shown when camera access is denied for this app; an Open Settings button follows.

chat.record.denied_microphone.comment: Card shown when the browser refused the microphone.

chat.record.denied_microphone_app.text: Lakko needs microphone access to record voice messages
chat.record.denied_microphone_app.comment: Card shown when microphone access is denied for this app; an Open Settings button follows.

chat.record.finishing.comment: Accessible name of the spinner shown while a recording is being saved.

chat.record.flip_camera.comment: Button that switches between the front and back camera while recording a video message.

chat.record.flip_failed.comment: Short notice when switching between the front and back camera failed while recording a video message.

chat.record.hint_hold.comment: Short hint after a quick tap on the record button: recording needs a press and hold.

chat.record.in_call.comment: Why the record button is disabled: a call is using the microphone.

chat.record.locked_hint.comment: Screen reader hint on the record button: activating it starts a recording that runs until it is stopped.

chat.record.no_camera.comment: Short notice: a video message cannot be recorded because there is no camera.

chat.record.open_app_settings.comment: Android: button on a camera or microphone permission card or dialog; opens Lakko's app info page in the Android system settings, where permissions are granted.

chat.record.open_settings.comment: iOS: button on a camera or microphone permission card; opens Lakko's page in the iOS Settings app. Use the name of the Settings app on iOS.

chat.record.pause.comment: Button that pauses listening to the recorded voice message before it is sent.

chat.record.pause_video.comment: Button on a recorded video message preview that pauses it.

chat.record.position.comment: Screen-reader label of the slider that moves through a recording before it is sent.

chat.record.recording_duration.comment: Screen reader label of the bar while a voice message is recorded; {duration} is the spoken length so far (for example 12 seconds).

chat.record.send.comment: Button that sends a finished voice or video message recording.

chat.record.silent_mic.comment: Shown on the recording bar when the microphone picks up nothing.

chat.record.slide_cancel.comment: Hint on the recording bar while the record button is held: slide sideways to cancel. The arrow points the way to slide.

chat.record.start_failed.comment: Short notice: the recording could not start.

chat.record.starting.comment: Shown on the recording bar while the microphone or camera is being opened.

chat.record.stop.comment: Accessible name of the button that stops a hands-free recording.

chat.record.stop_short.comment: Button that stops a hands-free recording.

chat.record.switch_to_video.comment: Button that switches the record button to recording round video messages.

chat.record.switch_to_voice.comment: Button that switches the record button to recording voice messages.

chat.record.unsupported_video.text: Video messages can't be recorded in this browser
chat.record.unsupported_video.comment: Why the record button is disabled: this browser cannot record video messages.

chat.record.unsupported_video_device.text: Video messages can't be recorded on this device
chat.record.unsupported_video_device.comment: Shown on the record button when this phone has no video format a video message can use.

chat.record.unsupported_voice.text: Voice messages can't be recorded in this browser
chat.record.unsupported_voice.comment: Why the record button is disabled: this browser cannot record voice messages.

chat.record.video.comment: Accessible name of the record button in video mode.

chat.record.video_ready.comment: Shown on the recording bar when a video message is recorded and waiting to be sent.

chat.record.video_tooltip.text: Record video message: hold to record, click to switch to voice

chat.record.voice.comment: Accessible name of the record button in voice mode.

chat.record.voice_tooltip.text: Record voice message: hold to record, click to switch to video
chat.record.voice_tooltip.comment: Web: mouse-hover tooltip of the record button in voice mode. Holding the button records; a click switches to video messages.

chat.refusal.add_not_admin.text: Only the group owner or an admin can add members.
chat.refusal.add_not_admin.comment: Refusal: the reader tried to add someone to a group but is neither its owner nor an admin.

chat.refusal.device_binding.text: Something is wrong with this device's key. Remove it from Devices and add it again.
chat.refusal.device_binding.comment: Refusal: this device's key is not accepted by the group; the person should remove the device in Devices and add it again.

chat.refusal.device_limit.text: {count, plural, one {Up to # device per account. Remove one first.} other {Up to # devices per account. Remove one first.}}
chat.refusal.device_limit.comment: Refusal: the account already has the most devices it may have in a conversation; one must be removed first.

chat.refusal.fallback.text: This change could not be requested.
chat.refusal.fallback.comment: A change to a group's membership or roles was refused for a reason that has no sentence of its own.

chat.refusal.group_kind_changed.text: This change can't be made to this conversation.
chat.refusal.group_kind_changed.comment: Refusal: the change would turn a one-to-one chat into a group or the reverse.

chat.refusal.join_not_kept.text: A join request arrived while too many were already waiting, so it was not kept. Ask the person to send it again later.
chat.refusal.join_not_kept.comment: Shown to a group admin: a join request arrived when too many were waiting and was dropped; the person should send it again later.

chat.refusal.joiner_member.text: That person has already joined this group.
chat.refusal.joiner_member.comment: Refusal: the person whose join request is being approved is already in the group.

chat.refusal.no_join_request.text: That join request is no longer waiting.
chat.refusal.no_join_request.comment: Refusal: the join request being approved or rejected is no longer pending.

chat.refusal.not_owner.text: Only the group owner can change admins or transfer ownership.
chat.refusal.not_owner.comment: Refusal: only the group owner can make or remove admins or hand ownership to someone else.

chat.refusal.one_to_one_fixed.text: A chat is always the same two people.
chat.refusal.one_to_one_fixed.comment: Refusal: nobody can be added to or removed from a one-to-one chat.

chat.refusal.one_to_one_no_roles.comment: Refusal: a one-to-one chat has no owner or admin roles to change.

chat.refusal.owner_cannot_leave.text: The group owner cannot leave the group.
chat.refusal.owner_cannot_leave.comment: Refusal: a group's owner cannot leave it (ownership must be transferred first).

chat.refusal.owner_not_member.text: Ownership can only be held by a current member of this group.
chat.refusal.owner_not_member.comment: Refusal: ownership can only be handed to someone who is currently in the group.

chat.refusal.owner_unremovable.text: The group owner cannot be removed.
chat.refusal.owner_unremovable.comment: Refusal: a group's owner cannot be removed from it.

chat.refusal.pending_full.text: Too many changes are already waiting to apply.
chat.refusal.pending_full.comment: Refusal: too many membership changes in this group are waiting to be applied.

chat.refusal.remove_not_admin.text: Only the group owner or an admin can remove members.
chat.refusal.remove_not_admin.comment: Refusal: the reader tried to remove someone from a group but is neither its owner nor an admin.

chat.refusal.retry_many.text: Wait for them to land, then try again.
chat.refusal.retry_many.comment: Added after a refusal caused by pending changes: try again once they are applied.

chat.refusal.retry_one.text: Wait for it to land, then try again.
chat.refusal.retry_one.comment: Added after a refusal caused by one pending change: try again once it is applied.

chat.refusal.role_change_pending.text: A role change is already waiting to apply.
chat.refusal.role_change_pending.comment: Refusal: another change of admins or owner in this group has not been applied yet.

chat.refusal.with_retry.comment: A refusal followed by when to try again: {fact} says what was refused, {retry} when to try again.

chat.reply.cancel.comment: Button that closes the reply strip above the composer.

chat.reply.fallback_excerpt.comment: Stands in for the quoted text of a reply when the quoted message carried none.

chat.reply.quote.comment: Accessible name of the quote block at the top of a reply when the quoted author is unknown.

chat.reply.quote_to.comment: Accessible name of the quote block at the top of a reply; {name} is who wrote the quoted message.

chat.reply.strip_label.comment: Accessible name of the strip above the composer showing the message being replied to.

chat.select.count.comment: Middle of the selection bar: how many messages are selected.

chat.select.count_limit.text: {count, plural, one {# selected, the limit} other {# selected, the limit}}
chat.select.count_limit.comment: Middle of the selection bar when the most messages that can be selected at once are selected.

chat.select.delete_helper.text: Only your own messages can be deleted.
chat.select.delete_helper.comment: Line under the selection bar when the selected messages include someone else's: only the reader's own messages can be deleted.

chat.select.delete_title.comment: Title of the dialog confirming deletion of the selected messages. The messages are deleted for everyone in the conversation.

chat.select.deleted_of.comment: Shown when deleting several selected messages stopped at a failure; the rest stay selected.

chat.select.forwarded_of.comment: Shown when forwarding several selected messages stopped at a failure; the rest stay selected.

chat.select.save.comment: Select mode action beside Delete and Forward: save every selected message.

chat.select.state_not_selected.comment: Screen reader value of a message's selection mark while selecting messages.

chat.select.state_selected.comment: Screen reader value of a message's selection mark while selecting messages.

chat.select.toolbar.comment: Accessible name of the bar with Forward and Delete for the selected messages.

chat.send.failed.comment: Shown when a message could not be sent; the message stays in the timeline with a retry action.

chat.system.join_request.comment: Line in the timeline where someone asked to join the group.

chat.system.member_joined.comment: Row in a group's timeline: this person became a member. {name} is the person's display name, or 'Member' when unknown.

chat.system.member_left.comment: Row in a group's timeline: this person is no longer a member (left or was removed). {name} is the person's display name, or 'Member' when unknown.

chat.timeline.setting_up.text: This conversation is still being set up on this device.
chat.timeline.setting_up.comment: Shown under Loading in a conversation this device has not finished joining.

chat.transfer.action.comment: Button that hands the group's ownership to another member; disabled until a new owner is chosen.

chat.transfer.action_named.comment: Button that hands the group's ownership to the chosen member {name}.

chat.transfer.become_member.comment: Option in the ownership transfer form: the current owner becomes a plain member afterwards.

chat.transfer.become_member_detail.text: You give up every group power immediately. Only the new owner can give any of it back.
chat.transfer.become_member_detail.comment: Consequence of the Become a regular member option.

chat.transfer.candidate_admin.comment: Accessible name of an admin in the list of possible new owners.

chat.transfer.irreversible_body.text: Only an owner can change roles. Once you transfer this group you cannot take it back, you cannot restore your own owner role, and you cannot change your own role again unless the new owner does it for you.
chat.transfer.irreversible_body.comment: Body in the ownership transfer form: the transfer is permanent and the reader loses the power to change roles.

chat.transfer.irreversible_title.comment: Headline in the ownership transfer form.

chat.transfer.leave_blocked.text: Transfer ownership first — a group cannot be left without an owner.
chat.transfer.leave_blocked.comment: Why the owner's Leave group button is disabled: ownership must be handed to someone first.

chat.transfer.new_owner.text: You are now the owner of this group.
chat.transfer.new_owner.comment: Headline shown to a member who has just been made the group owner.

chat.transfer.new_owner_body.text: You can add and remove members, change admins, and transfer ownership to someone else.
chat.transfer.new_owner_body.comment: Shown to a member who has just been made the group owner: what they can now do.

chat.transfer.new_owner_legend.comment: Heading of the list of members to choose the new group owner from.

chat.transfer.new_owner_named.text: {name} made you the owner of this group.
chat.transfer.new_owner_named.comment: Headline shown to a member who has just been made the group owner by {name}.

chat.transfer.no_candidates.text: There is no one else in this group to transfer it to.
chat.transfer.no_candidates.comment: Why Transfer ownership is disabled: the owner is alone in the group.

chat.transfer.pending.comment: An ownership transfer was requested and has not been applied yet.

chat.transfer.pending_named.comment: An ownership transfer to {name} was requested and has not been applied yet.

chat.transfer.role_change_pending.text: A role change is already waiting to apply. Wait for it to land, then try again.
chat.transfer.role_change_pending.comment: Why Transfer ownership is disabled: another role change has not been applied yet.

chat.transfer.role_legend.comment: Heading of the choice of what the current owner becomes after the transfer.

chat.transfer.stay_admin.comment: Option in the ownership transfer form: the current owner stays an admin afterwards.

chat.transfer.stay_admin_detail.text: You can still add and remove members. You can give this up later by asking the new owner.
chat.transfer.stay_admin_detail.comment: Consequence of the Stay an admin option.

chat.transfer.unlocks_leave.text: Once the change is applied, you can leave the group like any other member.
chat.transfer.unlocks_leave.comment: Line in the ownership transfer form: after the transfer is applied the reader may leave the group.

chat.typing.named.comment: Under the group name while one member is typing.

chat.typing.several.comment: Under the group name while more than one member is typing.

chat.unpin.for_everyone.comment: Option in a group: remove the pin every member sees.

chat.unpin.for_me.comment: Option: remove the reader's own pin from the message.

chat.unpin.sheet_title.comment: Title of the sheet asking whether to remove the reader's own pin or the pin everyone sees.

chat.upload.uploading_of.comment: Shown while one of several encrypted files is uploaded; {index} is which one, {total} how many.

chat.upload.working.comment: Shown while attached files are being prepared.

chat.video.load_failed.comment: Shown over a video that failed to load.

chat.video.load_failed_retry.comment: Accessible name of a video in a message that failed to load; activating it retries. Used on web, iOS and Android, so it must not say tap or click.

chat.video.loading.comment: Accessible name of a video in a message while it loads; {size} is its file size.

chat.video.open.comment: Screen-reader action of a video in a message: opens the player.

chat.video.play.comment: Accessible name of a video in a message; {size} is its file size.

chat.video.play_failed.comment: Shown in the full-screen video player when the video cannot be played.

chat.video.player.comment: Screen-reader label of the full-screen video player.

chat.video_note.poster.comment: Screen-reader label of the still picture shown on a video message before it plays.

chat.video_note.sound_on.comment: Web: corner label on a round video message playing without sound; activating it plays the sound. Must not say tap or click (mouse and touch both reach it).

chat.video_note.tap_mute.comment: Hint over a recorded video message being previewed with sound.

chat.video_note.tap_sound.comment: iOS: corner label on a round video message playing without sound; tapping it turns the sound on. chat.video_note.sound_on is the web wording.
