chats.row.people.comment: Chat list row, second line, of a group nothing has been said in yet: how many people are in it.

chats.row.pinned.comment: Tooltip of the icon on a chat list row pinned to the top of the list.

chats.row.unread.text: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
chats.row.unread.comment: Tooltip of the unread badge on a chat list row.

chats.row.unread_overflow.comment: Unread badge on a chat list row when there are 100 or more unread messages.

chats.search.clear.comment: Screen-reader label of the button that empties the search field of the conversation list.

chats.search.label.comment: Accessible name of the search field above the conversation list.

chats.search.no_results.comment: The conversation list search matched nothing on this device.

chats.search.placeholder.comment: Placeholder of the search field above the conversation list.

chats.synchronizing.comment: Status at the top of the conversation list while a newly added or restored device is still being admitted to the account's chats.

common.adding.comment: Add button while the item is being added.

common.back.comment: Accessibility label of the back arrow in a screen's top bar.

common.cancel.comment: Button that stops the operation in progress and returns to the form.

common.checking.comment: Busy label of a submit button while what was typed is checked.

common.clipboard.link.comment: Label the system shows with a link Lakko put on the clipboard (Android paste preview). Not shown inside the app.

common.clipboard.message.comment: Label the system shows with a message text Lakko put on the clipboard (Android paste preview). Not shown inside the app.

common.close.comment: Accessibility label of a button that closes a sheet or dialog, e.g. the language list opened from the sign-in screen.

common.collapse.comment: Accessibility label of the arrow that closes an expanded row.

common.collapsed.comment: Accessibility value of a section that is closed.

common.confirm.comment: Button that confirms what the screen asks for.

common.confirming.comment: Confirm button while the confirmation is being sent.

common.connecting.comment: Progress label while a connection is being set up.

common.continue.comment: Button that moves a form to its next step.

common.copied.comment: Label the Copy button shows for a moment after it copied.

common.copy.comment: Button that copies the text next to it to the clipboard.

common.creating.comment: A Create button while the thing it creates (an invite link, a channel) is being made.

common.dismiss.comment: Button (and accessibility label) that hides a notice.

common.duration.hours.comment: A spoken duration in hours, for screen readers and the call history.

common.duration.minutes.comment: A spoken duration in minutes, for screen readers.

common.duration.minutes_seconds.comment: A spoken duration of minutes and seconds; {minutes} and {seconds} are the two parts already written out.

common.duration.pair.comment: Joins two parts of a spoken duration, largest first, such as '1 hour' and '5 minutes'; applied pair by pair for three parts.

common.duration.seconds.comment: A spoken duration in seconds, for screen readers.

common.error.a11y.comment: Spoken by the screen reader for an inline error under a field. {message} is the error text.

common.error.offline.text: Could not reach Lakko. Check your connection and try again.
common.error.offline.comment: Error when the device could not reach the server at all.

common.error.qr_render.text: Could not draw the code. Try again.
common.error.qr_render.comment: A QR code (a pairing code or an authenticator setup code) could not be drawn on screen.

common.error.server_unreachable.text: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
common.error.server_unreachable.comment: Error when the server could not be reached.

common.error.session_ended.text: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
common.error.session_ended.comment: The signed-in session is gone; the action needs a new sign-in.

common.error.session_expired.comment: The server no longer accepts this session.

common.error.session_not_ready.comment: An action was tried before the signed-in session finished loading.

common.error.starting_up.text: Lakko is still starting up. Try again in a moment.
common.error.starting_up.comment: Error when an action is tried before the app has finished loading the account's keys.

common.error.too_many_attempts.text: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
common.error.too_many_attempts.comment: The server is limiting attempts for a short time. Never means the account is locked or the input was wrong.

common.error.too_many_attempts_minutes.text: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
common.error.too_many_attempts_minutes.comment: The server is limiting attempts; {minutes} is how long to wait, in minutes.

common.error.unavailable.text: That is not available right now. Try again later.
common.error.unavailable.comment: Error when the server refused because a service is temporarily down.

common.expand.comment: Accessibility label of the arrow that opens a collapsed row.

common.expanded.comment: Accessibility value of a section that is open.

common.fact_pair.comment: Joins two short facts on one line, such as a date and "Used up" under an invite link, or a handle and a subscriber count under a channel. Applied pair by pair for longer lists.

common.list_pair.comment: Joins items of a short list of names, applied pair by pair: {first} is everything so far, {second} the next name. Use the language's list separator, without a word for 'and'.

common.loading.comment: Shown while a screen is still loading.

common.looking_up.comment: Busy label of a button while an account is looked up.

common.manage.comment: Row action that opens a page where something is managed (devices, passkeys).

common.more_options.comment: Title of a collapsed section with less common choices.

common.not_now.comment: Button that closes a request (such as a permission card) without acting on it.

common.off.comment: State of a switch that is off.

common.ok.comment: Button that closes a notice after it has been read.

common.on.comment: State of a switch that is on.

common.open.comment: Button that opens the thing it stands next to, such as a pasted call link or a call from a link.

common.open_chat.comment: Button that opens the conversation just joined or started (after joining a group by link, after accepting a contact invite).

common.open_lakko.comment: Link from a public page (call or invite link) into the app.

common.optional.comment: Placeholder of a field that may be left empty.

common.paste.comment: Button that pastes the clipboard into a form.

common.preparing.comment: Shown while something is being set up.

common.qr_code.comment: Accessible name of a QR code image, for example the authenticator setup code.

common.remove.comment: Button that removes an item from a list (a passkey, a device, a recovery factor).

common.removing.comment: Remove button while the item is being removed.

common.retry.comment: Button that tries a failed action again.

common.saving.comment: Save button while the change is being saved.

common.sending.comment: Busy label of a button while a code is being sent.

common.sentence_pair.comment: Two whole sentences shown together, in this order.

common.size.bytes.comment: A file size in bytes; {size} is the number already formatted.

common.size.gb.comment: A file size in gigabytes; {size} is the number already formatted with one decimal.

common.size.kb.comment: A file size in kilobytes; {size} is the number already formatted with one decimal.

common.size.mb.comment: A file size in megabytes; {size} is the number already formatted with one decimal.

common.time.days_ago.text: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
common.time.days_ago.comment: Relative time, inserted into a sentence such as "Refreshed {when}."

common.time.hours_ago.text: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
common.time.hours_ago.comment: Relative time, inserted into a sentence such as "Refreshed {when}."

common.time.just_now.comment: Relative time under a minute, inserted into a sentence such as "Refreshed {when}." Lower case in English.

common.time.minutes_ago.text: {count, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
common.time.minutes_ago.comment: Relative time, inserted into a sentence such as "Refreshed {when}."

common.try_again.comment: Button that repeats an operation that failed.

common.undo.comment: Button in a short notice that reverses what was just done.

common.unknown.comment: Shown in place of a date or value that could not be read.

contacts.accept.error.old_version.text: This request came from an older version of Lakko. Ask them to update and send it again.
contacts.accept.error.old_version.comment: An accepted contact request cannot open a chat because the sender's app is too old.

contacts.add.share_invite.comment: Add-menu item on the contacts list: open the invite links.

contacts.add_back.action.comment: Button on the "Add to contacts" card.

contacts.add_back.control.comment: Title of the card on the page of a person the viewer removed from their contacts while their one-to-one remains. Puts them back on the list.

contacts.add_back.sub.text: Puts {name} back on your contact list on this account.
contacts.add_back.sub.comment: Line under "Add to contacts": what it does. Local; nothing is sent. {name} is the person's name.

contacts.detail.actions.comment: Accessible name of the row of Message / Call / Video buttons on a contact's page.

contacts.detail.call_needs_chat.text: Send a message first to start a call.
contacts.detail.call_needs_chat.comment: Tooltip of the disabled Call and Video buttons when there is no chat with this contact on this device yet.

contacts.detail.gone_body.text: This person is no longer in your contacts.
contacts.detail.gone_body.comment: Shown on the contact page and the safety number page when the contact was removed while it was open.

contacts.detail.gone_title.comment: Title of the contact page when the contact was removed while it was open.

contacts.detail.message.comment: Button on a contact's page that opens (or starts) the chat with them.

contacts.detail.message_unavailable.text: This contact was added before chats could be started from here. Ask them to message you.
contacts.detail.message_unavailable.comment: Tooltip of the disabled Message button for a contact whose account is not known.

contacts.detail.their_name.comment: Line under a contact you renamed: the name they chose for themselves. {name} is that name.

contacts.detail.username_not_verified.comment: Line under a contact's name when the username they claim has not been confirmed by the directory to belong to their key.

contacts.error.send.text: Could not send the request. Try again.
contacts.error.send.comment: A contact request failed for a reason with no message of its own.

contacts.error.start_chat.text: Could not start the chat. Try again.
contacts.error.start_chat.comment: Starting the one-to-one chat with a contact failed (after accepting a request, or from Message on the contact card).

contacts.identity_changed.unconfirmed.text: {name}'s secure identity changed and could not be confirmed against the transparency log. Verify out of band before trusting.
contacts.identity_changed.unconfirmed.comment: A contact's identity key changed and the transparency log could not be checked. Neither a reset nor a compromise is claimed. {name} is the contact's @username.

contacts.identity_changed.unconfirmed_un.text: This contact's secure identity changed and could not be confirmed against the transparency log. Verify out of band before trusting.
contacts.identity_changed.unconfirmed_un.comment: Same as contacts.identity_changed.unconfirmed when the contact's name is not known.

contacts.identity_changed.unexplained.text: {name}'s secure identity changed, and the transparency log does NOT show an owner reset — treat this as a possible account compromise. Verify out of band before trusting.
contacts.identity_changed.unexplained.comment: A contact's identity key changed and the key transparency log shows no owner reset: a possible compromise. {name} is the contact's @username. Keep the emphasis on NOT.

contacts.identity_changed.unexplained_un.text: This contact's secure identity changed, and the transparency log does NOT show an owner reset — treat this as a possible account compromise. Verify out of band before trusting.
contacts.identity_changed.unexplained_un.comment: Same as contacts.identity_changed.unexplained when the contact's name is not known.

contacts.invite_links.subtitle.text: Share a link with someone you want to hear from.

contacts.invite_links.title.comment: Heading of the pane listing the person's contact invite links.

contacts.list.add.comment: Tooltip and accessible name of the + button on the contacts list that opens the add menu.

contacts.list.empty.body.text: Find someone by name or username in the search field above, or share your invite link.
contacts.list.empty.body.comment: Empty contacts list, line under the heading.

contacts.list.requests.comment: Section heading on the contacts list: incoming and sent contact requests.

contacts.list.search.comment: Accessible name of the search field on the contacts list.

contacts.list.section_index.comment: Accessible name of the letter index down the right edge of the contact list (tap or drag to jump to a letter).

contacts.list.sent.comment: Collapsible group of contact requests this account sent that are not answered yet. {count} is how many.

contacts.list.sent_dismiss.comment: Tooltip of Dismiss on a sent contact request; it only hides the row, the request is not withdrawn.

contacts.list.sent_waiting.comment: Status line of a sent contact request not yet accepted.

contacts.mailbox.chat_join_failed.text: Someone started a chat with you, but it could not be opened on this device. Ask them to add you again.
contacts.mailbox.chat_join_failed.comment: Banner on the contacts screen when a chat invitation (MLS Welcome) from a contact arrived but could not be opened on this device.

contacts.mailbox.join_failed.text: You were added to a group, but the invitation could not be opened on this device. Ask the person who added you to add you again.
contacts.mailbox.join_failed.comment: Banner shown when a group invitation (MLS Welcome) arrived but could not be opened.

contacts.mailbox.poll_failed.text: Couldn't check for new contact requests. Trying again.
contacts.mailbox.poll_failed.comment: Checking for new contact requests failed; the app retries by itself.

contacts.mailbox.sign_in.text: Sign in again to check for new requests.
contacts.mailbox.sign_in.comment: Checking for contact requests needs keys this session does not hold.

contacts.reauth.body.text: The keys this session needs for contacts are not available. Sign in again to use Contacts.
contacts.reauth.body.comment: Web: shown on the Contacts screen when the tab holds no identity secrets.

contacts.remove.body.text: Any chats you share stay as they are; only your contact list changes. You can add them again later.
contacts.remove.body.comment: Body of the confirmation before removing a contact: states exactly what removal does and does not do.

contacts.remove.confirm_named.comment: Confirm button of the contact removal, naming the contact. Without a name the button reads "Remove" (common.remove).

contacts.remove.control.comment: Title of the card on a contact's page that removes the contact.

contacts.remove.sub.text: Takes {name} off your contact list on this account.
contacts.remove.sub.comment: Line under "Remove contact": what removal does. {name} is the contact's name.

contacts.remove.title.comment: Title of the confirmation before removing a contact.

contacts.rename.action.comment: Button that opens the field to rename a contact.

contacts.rename.field.comment: Accessible name of the rename field.

contacts.rename.placeholder.text: Leave blank to use their own name

contacts.rename.sub_local.text: Your name for this contact. Only you see it.
contacts.rename.sub_local.comment: Line under "Name" when you have renamed the contact.

contacts.rename.sub_theirs.text: Shown as they set it. You can give them your own name.
contacts.rename.sub_theirs.comment: Line under "Name" when you have not renamed the contact.

contacts.rename.title.comment: Title of the card on a contact's page where you set your own name for them.

contacts.request.accept.comment: Button that accepts an incoming contact request (the person becomes a trusted contact).

contacts.request.decline.comment: Button that declines an incoming contact request.

contacts.request.no_intro.comment: Line on an incoming contact request that carries no introduction.

contacts.request.someone.comment: Name of the sender of a contact request when nothing is known about them yet: no profile name, no verified username.

contacts.safety.body.text: Compare it with {name} in person or on a call. Matching numbers mean nobody is between you.
contacts.safety.body.comment: Explanation under "Verify safety number". {name} is the contact's name. Must keep the meaning: equal numbers mean no one intercepts the conversation.

contacts.safety.body_unnamed.text: Compare it with your contact in person or on a call. Matching numbers mean nobody is between you.
contacts.safety.body_unnamed.comment: Twin of contacts.safety.body used when the contact's name is not known.

contacts.safety.error.text: Could not compute the safety number. Try again.

contacts.safety.number.comment: Accessible name of the displayed safety number digits.

contacts.safety.row_sub.text: Compare a number in person to confirm this is really them.
contacts.safety.row_sub.comment: Line under Verify safety number on a contact's page.

contacts.safety.show.comment: Button that reveals the safety number. Its opposite is "Hide" (chat.attachment.hide).

contacts.safety.sign_in.text: Sign in again to see the safety number.
contacts.safety.sign_in.comment: The safety number cannot be computed because this session holds no keys.

contacts.safety.title.comment: Title of the card on a contact's page that shows the safety number to compare.

contacts.scan_qr.comment: Contacts action: opens the camera to scan a Lakko link shown as a QR code, such as someone's invite link.

contacts.scan_qr.not_a_link.text: This code is not a Lakko link. Try another code.
contacts.scan_qr.not_a_link.comment: Shown on the scanner when the scanned QR code is not a Lakko invite, group or call link.

desktop.capture.body.text: Allow it in your system's privacy settings, then try again.
desktop.capture.body.comment: Second line of the desktop screen shown when the operating system refused Lakko the microphone or camera.

desktop.capture.camera.title.comment: Title of the desktop screen shown when the operating system refused Lakko the camera.

desktop.capture.microphone.title.comment: Title of the desktop screen shown when the operating system refused Lakko the microphone.

desktop.capture.open_settings.comment: Button that opens the operating system's privacy settings for the microphone or camera.

desktop.quit_call.confirm.comment: Desktop app: confirm button of the quit-during-a-call question.

desktop.quit_call.title.comment: Desktop app: question shown when the person quits Lakko during a call.

desktop.still_running.body.text: You'll get messages and calls. Quit from the tray icon to stop.
desktop.still_running.body.comment: Body of the one notification shown the first time the window closes while Lakko keeps running, on Windows and Linux.

desktop.still_running.title.comment: Title of the one notification shown the first time the window closes while Lakko keeps running, on Windows and Linux.

desktop.tray.open.comment: Tray icon menu item that opens the window, on Windows and Linux.

desktop.tray.quit.comment: Tray icon menu item that stops the app, on Windows and Linux.

device_link.code.enter_six_digits.text: Enter the six digits your other device shows.
device_link.code.enter_six_digits.comment: Error under the code field when what was typed is not six digits.

device_link.code.expired.comment: Shown on the new device when the sign-in request was not answered in time.

device_link.code.field_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the six-digit code field on the new device.

device_link.code.intro.text: Open Lakko in a browser or on your phone where you are already signed in. It will show a six-digit code. Enter it here.
device_link.code.intro.comment: Instructions above the code field on the new device: the code comes from the person's own signed-in device.

device_link.code.intro_native.text: Open Lakko on a device that is already signed in. It will show a six-digit code. Enter it here.
device_link.code.intro_native.comment: Native (iOS, Android) instructions above the code field on the new device; the code comes from the person's own signed-in device. The web says 'in a browser or on your phone' instead.

device_link.code.restoring.comment: Shown on the new device after the signed-in device confirmed the code, while the account is carried across.

device_link.code.start_again.comment: Button on the new device after a wrong code, a decline or an expiry: sends a new sign-in request.

device_link.code.title.comment: Heading of the iOS and Android panel on a new device where the person types the code their signed-in device shows.

device_link.code.unreachable.text: Could not reach Lakko. Check your connection, then start again.
device_link.code.unreachable.comment: Shown on the new device when the request or the code could not be sent.

device_link.code.use_instead.comment: Link under the QR code on a new device (iOS, Android): go back to typing the code a signed-in device shows.

device_link.code.waiting.comment: Under the disabled code field until the signed-in device has answered.

device_link.code.wrong.text: That code does not match. Start again and enter the code your other device shows.
device_link.code.wrong.comment: Shown on the new device after a wrong code: each request allows one try.

device_link.error.ask_unavailable.text: Asking your other device is not available right now; the QR code still works.
device_link.error.ask_unavailable.comment: The server cannot pass the request to other devices; the QR code is offered instead.

device_link.error.ask_unreachable.text: Could not reach the server to ask your other device; the QR code still works.
device_link.error.ask_unreachable.comment: The request to other devices could not be sent; the QR code is offered instead.

device_link.error.declined.comment: The other device refused the sign-in.

device_link.error.generic.text: Could not restore from your other device. Try again, or use your recovery phrase.
device_link.error.generic.comment: Restoring from another device failed for a reason with no more specific message.

device_link.error.identity_mismatch.text: The identity received from your other device doesn't match this account's published identity — refusing to use it.
device_link.error.identity_mismatch.comment: The identity from the other device does not match the account; it is refused for safety.

device_link.error.name_other_account.text: The name you typed belongs to a different account. Nothing was changed on this device.
device_link.error.name_other_account.comment: Restoring from another device: the username typed on this device resolves to a different account than the one the other device answered for, so nothing was saved.

device_link.error.no_identity.text: The other device confirmed but did not send your identity. Update Lakko on it and try again, or use your recovery phrase.
device_link.error.no_identity.comment: The other device confirmed without sending the identity.

device_link.error.not_let_in.text: Your other device sent the identity, but this device could not be let in. Try again, or use your recovery phrase.
device_link.error.not_let_in.comment: The identity arrived but signing in on this device failed.

device_link.error.request_limited.text: Too many requests to your other devices. Try again in a few minutes.
device_link.error.request_limited.comment: The server limits how often other devices are asked.

device_link.error.timeout.text: The other device did not answer in time. Try again.
device_link.error.timeout.comment: Nobody confirmed on another device in time.

device_link.error.wrong_account.text: The other device answered for a different account. Nothing was changed on this device.
device_link.error.wrong_account.comment: Restoring from another device: the device that answered belongs to a different account than the one this device asked for, so nothing was saved.

device_link.keys_not_sent.text: This device could not hand over your keys to the new device. On the new device, use a passkey or your recovery phrase instead.
device_link.keys_not_sent.comment: Shown on the signed-in device after it confirmed a new device but could not give it a session and the recovery phrase (it does not hold the phrase, or sending failed).

device_link.pairing.needs_username.text: Set a username first to add another device.
device_link.pairing.needs_username.comment: An account without a username cannot add another device.

device_link.pairing.unsupported.text: This code comes from a different version of Lakko. Update Lakko on both devices and try again.
device_link.pairing.unsupported.comment: The new device runs a version this one cannot read.

device_link.pairing.wrong_account.text: This code is for a different account. Check that the new device uses the same username as this one.
device_link.pairing.wrong_account.comment: The new device asked to join a different account.

device_link.qr.intro.text: Show this code to a device that still has your account. It adds this device and transfers your identity end-to-end encrypted, with no phrase to type.
device_link.qr.intro.comment: Line above the pairing code shown on a new device.

device_link.qr.scan_hint.text: On your other device, open Settings, then Devices, then Add a device, and scan this code.
device_link.qr.scan_hint.comment: Instruction under the pairing QR code.

device_link.qr.show.comment: Button that shows a QR code as an alternative to confirming.

device_link.qr.waiting.text: Waiting for your other device to scan this code...
device_link.qr.waiting.comment: Shown under the pairing QR code while the other device has not scanned it yet.

device_link.request.adding.comment: Busy label while the new device is added.

device_link.request.code_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the six-digit code shown in the sign-in request dialog.

device_link.request.decline.comment: Button that refuses a new device's request to join.

device_link.request.declined.text: Declined. If this keeps happening, change your password.
device_link.request.declined.comment: Shown after the request was refused.

device_link.request.enter_code.text: Enter this code on the new device:
device_link.request.enter_code.comment: Line above the six-digit code shown on the signed-in device; the person types it on the new device.

device_link.request.error.generic.text: Could not add the device. Try again.
device_link.request.error.generic.comment: Adding the new device failed for a reason with no more specific message.

device_link.request.error.no_device_key.text: No device key on this browser. Sign in again.
device_link.request.error.no_device_key.comment: This browser lost its device key; signing in again fixes it.

device_link.request.expired.text: The sign-in request expired. Nothing was added.
device_link.request.expired.comment: Toast on a signed-in device when the 'Is this you?' request from a new device ran out of time before it was confirmed.

device_link.request.handled_elsewhere.text: This sign-in request was handled on another device.
device_link.request.handled_elsewhere.comment: Short notice on a signed-in device when another device of the same account answered the request first.

device_link.request.heading.comment: Title of the dialog on a signed-in device when a new device asks to join the account by the six-digit code.

device_link.request.never_share.text: Never read this code to anyone. Lakko will never ask for it.
device_link.request.never_share.comment: Warning under the six-digit sign-in code: whoever types it gets into the account.

device_link.request.not_recorded.text: Could not reach Lakko to finish adding the device. Nothing was added. Try again from the new device.
device_link.request.not_recorded.comment: Shown on the signed-in device when the outcome could not be sent to the server, so nothing was paired.

device_link.request.someone_signing_in.text: Someone is signing in to your account on a new device.
device_link.request.someone_signing_in.comment: First line of the sign-in request dialog, before the person says whether it is them. Followed by the question Is this you?

device_link.request.title.comment: Title of the prompt on a signed-in device when a new device asks to join.

device_link.request.too_many.text: Too many sign-in requests today. Use a QR code, or try again tomorrow.
device_link.request.too_many.comment: Shown on the signed-in device when it already answered the day's maximum of sign-in requests; the request was declined.

device_link.request.wrong_code.text: The code did not match. Nothing was added.
device_link.request.wrong_code.comment: Short notice on the signed-in device when the new device typed a wrong code: no device joined.

device_link.request.yes_its_me.comment: Button in the sign-in request dialog: the person confirms they are the one signing in. Only then does this device show a code to type on the new device.

device_link.restored.comment: Shown when the restore from another device finished.

device_link.show_code.comment: Button that starts the another-device sign-in and shows the code.

device_link.transferring.comment: Shown while the identity arrives from the other device.

devices.add.e2ee_note.text: Linking is end-to-end encrypted between your two devices.
devices.add.e2ee_note.comment: Line at the top of the add-a-device screen.

devices.add.error.generic.text: Could not link this device. Try again.

devices.add.joining.comment: Progress on the new device after the other device scanned its code.

devices.add.linked.text: Linked. This device is now part of your account.
devices.add.linked.comment: The new device was linked to the account.

devices.add.side.scan.comment: Segment on the add-a-device screen: this device is signed in, it scans the new device's code.

devices.add.side.scan_detail.text: This device is already signed in: it scans the new device's code and lets it in.

protect.passkey.body.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. No password to remember.
protect.passkey.body.comment: Under 'Create a passkey' on the protect-your-account step.

protect.phrase.body.text: 12 words only you keep. Stronger, and nothing to do with email.
protect.phrase.body.comment: Under 'Save a recovery phrase' on the protect-your-account step.

protect.phrase.save.body.text: 12 words that only you keep. After this, a code by email can change your password but cannot open your account.
protect.phrase.save.body.comment: First paragraph of the 'Save a recovery phrase' screen.

protect.phrase.save.effect.text: This gives your account new keys. Your contacts and chats stay as they are. Your other devices stay signed in.

protect.phrase.save.failed.text: We could not finish. Nothing changed.
protect.phrase.save.failed.comment: The key change behind saving a phrase failed.

protect.phrase.save.finishing.text: Your account has new keys. Finishing up.
protect.phrase.save.finishing.comment: Shown while the last steps of saving a phrase are still owed; the words appear after it.

protect.phrase.save.progress.comment: Progress line while 'Save a recovery phrase' is working.

protect.phrase.title.comment: Row title; also the title of the Settings screen that shows the 12 words for the first time.

protect.skip.comment: Plain button that skips the protect-your-account step.

protect.skip.confirm.body.text: If you forget your password, or lose this phone, you will not be able to get back into this account.
protect.skip.confirm.body.comment: Body of the confirmation after 'Not now'.

protect.skip.confirm.title.comment: Title of the confirmation after 'Not now'.

protect.title.comment: Heading of the step after sign-up where the person chooses how to get back in later.

recall.phrase.changed.text: This account's keys were changed on {date}. Was that you?
recall.phrase.changed.comment: Shown after the person typed the phrase of the account as it was before a recent reset. {date} is a localized date.

recall.phrase.take_back.comment: Button starting the take-back with the phrase.

recall.phrase.use.comment: Under the password field of the 'Was it you?' form.

recall.phrase.wrong.text: Those words are not this account's recovery phrase.
recall.phrase.wrong.comment: Wrong phrase on the take-the-account-back form.

recovery.access_only_note.text: An authenticator code logs you in. On a device that has never held this account you then still need another device, a passkey or your recovery phrase.
recovery.access_only_note.comment: Note under the list of recovery methods.

recovery.access_only_note_words.text: Three words or an authenticator code log you in. On a device that has never held this account you need another device, a passkey or your recovery phrase.
recovery.access_only_note_words.comment: Note under the list of recovery methods on a device that offers the three-words method. recovery.access_only_note is the wording where it is not offered.

recovery.cached_account.comment: On a recovery form, names the account saved on this device. {username} is '@name'.

recovery.device.intro.text: Enter your username, then open Lakko on a device that is still logged in and type the code it shows. No camera needed; a QR code is there if you prefer.
recovery.device.intro.comment: Line at the top of recovery from another device (signed out): the signed-in device shows a code that the person types here.

recovery.device.intro_qr.text: Your other device links this one and carries your account across.
recovery.device.intro_qr.comment: Line under the 'Another device' recovery title when the link runs by scanning a QR code.

recovery.device.restoring.comment: Heading while another device restores the account; {username} is the username with @.

recovery.email.check.body.text: If that username and address belong together, a code is on its way. It works for 10 minutes.
recovery.email.check.body.comment: Shown whether or not a letter was sent; must not reveal which.

recovery.email.check.title.comment: Heading of the code step. Shown whatever was typed.

recovery.email.failed.text: We could not bring back your account. Try again, or choose another way.
recovery.email.failed.comment: The keys kept for the account could not be opened after the code was accepted. Nothing was changed.

recovery.email.restoring.comment: Progress line while the keys are being restored after the code.

recovery.email.row.body.text: A code sent to your recovery email.

recovery.email.row.title.comment: Row on the 'Get back in' list.

recovery.email.save.comment: Main button of the new-password step.

recovery.email.start.body.text: Type your username and your recovery email.
recovery.email.start.body.comment: Under the heading of the first step.

recovery.email.totp.body.text: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

recovery.email.totp.lost.text: Lost your authenticator? Use another way to get back in.
recovery.email.totp.lost.comment: Link back to the list of ways.

recovery.email.totp.title.comment: Heading of the extra step when the account has an authenticator.

recovery.error.generic.text: Could not recover the account. Check the words and try again.
recovery.error.generic.comment: Recovery failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.error.no_match.text: That did not match this account. Check the words and the username, then try again.
recovery.error.no_match.comment: Recovery failed. Deliberately the same whether the username or the words were wrong.

recovery.error.rate_limited.text: Too many attempts. Try again in {time}.
recovery.error.rate_limited.comment: The server is limiting attempts on a recovery form; {time} is the remaining wait as minutes:seconds in Latin digits, such as 14:59, counting down. Never means the account is locked or the input was wrong.

recovery.error.unavailable.text: This method is not available right now. Choose another one.
recovery.error.unavailable.comment: A recovery method is switched off on this server. Shown in place of the method's form, above a button that leads back to the list.

recovery.group.keys.comment: Plain heading on the "Get back in" screen over the ways that restore the account's keys and so the chats: another device, a passkey, the recovery phrase.

recovery.group.signin.text: Logs you in on this device
recovery.group.signin.comment: Plain heading on the "Get back in" screen over the ways that only sign the person in (an authenticator code) and do not bring chats to a new device.

recovery.lede.comment: Line under the recovery title, above the list of methods.

recovery.lede_account.text: Choose how to get back into {username}.
recovery.lede_account.comment: Line under the recovery title when an account is saved on this device; {username} is its username with @.

recovery.method.device.sub.text: If you have one that is still logged in.
recovery.method.device.sub.comment: Subtitle of the another-device method, the first row.

recovery.method.device.title.comment: Recovery method: confirm from another signed-in device.

recovery.method.passkey.sub.text: Logs you in. Brings back your chats too if you turned that on for this passkey.
recovery.method.passkey.sub.comment: Subtitle of the passkey method on the "Get back in" screen. A passkey always signs in; it restores the chats only when the person chose that for the passkey in Settings.

recovery.method.passkey.title.comment: Recovery method: sign in with a passkey (face, fingerprint or screen lock).

recovery.method.phrase.restore_sub.comment: Subtitle of the recovery phrase method on the restore-identity screen.

recovery.method.phrase.sub.text: Type your 12 words and choose a new password.
recovery.method.phrase.sub.comment: Subtitle of the recovery phrase method.

recovery.method.phrase.title.comment: Recovery method: type the 12-word recovery phrase.

recovery.method.totp.sub.text: A code from your authenticator app.

recovery.method.totp.title.comment: Recovery method: a code from an authenticator app.

recovery.method.words.sub.text: Type three words of your recovery phrase. This device checks them.
recovery.method.words.sub.comment: Subtitle of the three-words method. The check happens on the device, against the phrase it holds; no server is involved.

recovery.method.words.title.comment: Recovery method, listed only on a device that still holds the recovery phrase: type three words of the phrase and the device checks them itself.

recovery.methods.back.comment: Accessibility label of the back button over a chosen recovery method.

recovery.methods.back_to_list.comment: Button under 'This method is not available right now': returns to the list of recovery methods.

recovery.new_password.error.generic.text: Could not save the password. Try again.
recovery.new_password.error.generic.comment: Saving the new password failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.new_password.lede.text: You are logged in. Set a new password so you can log in next time.

recovery.new_password.not_now.comment: Button that skips choosing a new password for now; the old password stays valid.

recovery.new_password.save.comment: Button that saves the new password.

recovery.new_password.saved.comment: Confirmation after the new password is saved.

recovery.new_password.title.comment: Title of the step shown right after someone who forgot their password got back in on a device that has their chats.

recovery.passkey.intro.text: Use the passkey you saved for Lakko. Your device will ask for your face, fingerprint or screen lock.
recovery.passkey.intro.comment: Instructions of the passkey form, above its one button.

recovery.passkey.submit.comment: Button that opens the system or browser passkey prompt.

recovery.passkey.unsupported.text: This device or browser does not support passkeys. Choose another way.
recovery.passkey.unsupported.comment: Shown in place of the passkey form where passkeys are not available.

recovery.passkey.waiting.comment: Busy label of the passkey button while the system or browser passkey prompt is open.

recovery.phrase.intro.text: Type your 12 words in order, then choose a new password.
recovery.phrase.intro.comment: Instructions of the recovery phrase form.

recovery.remembered.comment: Line at the bottom of the recovery screen; {link} is the 'Log in' link.

recovery.submit.comment: Submit button of the recovery forms.

recovery.title.comment: Title of the screen that lists the ways back into an account.

recovery.totp.code_label.comment: Label of the authenticator code field.

recovery.totp.error.enter_code.text: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
recovery.totp.error.enter_code.comment: The authenticator code field is empty or not six digits.

recovery.totp.error.generic.text: Could not check the code. Try again.
recovery.totp.error.generic.comment: Authenticator recovery failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.totp.error.unavailable.text: Authenticator code is not available here. Choose another way.
recovery.totp.error.unavailable.comment: The server has the authenticator-code method switched off. 'Authenticator code' is the method title (recovery.method.totp.title).

recovery.totp.error.wrong.text: That code did not work. Check the app and try the next one.
recovery.totp.error.wrong.comment: The authenticator code was not accepted.

recovery.totp.error.wrong_username.text: That code did not work. Check the username and the app, then try again.
recovery.totp.error.wrong_username.comment: The authenticator code or the username was not accepted.

recovery.totp.intro.text: Use the six-digit code from the authenticator app you set up in Settings. It logs you in; on a device that has never held this account you then still need another device, a passkey or your recovery phrase.

recovery.username_required.text: Enter the username of the account.
recovery.username_required.comment: A recovery form was submitted without a username.

recovery.username_required_to_recover.text: Enter the username of the account to recover.
recovery.username_required_to_recover.comment: Recovery was started with no username typed and none remembered on this device.

recovery.words.error.generic.text: The words matched, but logging in failed. Try again.
recovery.words.error.generic.comment: The three words were right, but the sign-in that follows failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.words.error.rejected.text: The recovery phrase saved on this device did not log you in to this account, so three words are paused on this device. Choose another way.
recovery.words.error.rejected.comment: The three words were right for the phrase stored on this device, but the server did not accept that phrase for the account (for example the account got a new recovery phrase on another device). The three-word route is then paused on this device.

recovery.words.error.unavailable.text: This device does not hold your recovery phrase, so it cannot check three words. Choose another way.
recovery.words.error.unavailable.comment: The three-words form was opened on a device that does not hold the recovery phrase, so it has nothing to check the words against.

recovery.words.paused.text: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {time}.
recovery.words.paused.comment: The three-words form is paused on this device after five wrong answers; {time} is the remaining wait as minutes:seconds in Latin digits, such as 14:59, counting down.

recovery.words.prompt.text: Type words {positions} of your recovery phrase.
recovery.words.prompt.comment: Which words to type; {positions} is a list of three word numbers in the order they are asked for, such as '7, 3 and 12', shown bold, in Latin digits. The numbers are drawn at random for every prompt.

recovery.words.signin_only.text: This device checks the words itself and logs you in. You then choose a new password.
recovery.words.signin_only.comment: Note under the three word fields: the check is local, it signs the person in, and the next screen asks for a new password.

recovery.words.submit.comment: Submit button of the three-words form.

recovery.words.tries_left.text: {count, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}} before a 15-minute pause.
recovery.words.tries_left.comment: Shown after a wrong answer on the three-words form; {count} is how many more wrong answers this device accepts before the form pauses for 15 minutes.

recovery_email.add_again.body.text: Your account's keys changed. Type your address again so a code by email can bring your account back.

recovery_email.add_again.title.comment: Row and banner action when the account's keys changed and email can no longer bring the account back.

recovery_email.body.text: If you forget your password, we send a code to this address so you can get back in.
recovery_email.body.comment: Under the title of the recovery email screen.

recovery_email.code.expired.comment: When adding an address and the code is too old.

recovery_email.code.other_address.comment: Button back to the address step.

recovery_email.code.resend.comment: Button that sends a new code.

recovery_email.code.resend_in.comment: Disabled state of that button; {time} is minutes:seconds in Latin digits.

recovery_email.code.sent_to.comment: {address} is the address just typed, shown back once.

recovery_email.code.title.comment: Heading of the code step when adding an address.

recovery_email.code.used_up.text: Too many attempts. Send a new code.

recovery_email.code.wrong.comment: Wrong, expired-looking or never-sent code; deliberately the same line for all.

recovery_email.invalid.comment: Under the address field when it does not parse.

recovery_email.mailbox_warning.text: Anyone who can read this mailbox can get into your account. Save a recovery phrase to change that.
recovery_email.mailbox_warning.comment: Shown under the address field only while no recovery phrase is saved.

recovery_email.needs_username.comment: A guest account opened the recovery email screen.

recovery_email.not_kept.text: Lakko does not keep your address. You will type it again, together with your username, when you need a code.

recovery_email.remove.confirm.body.text: You will not be able to get back in by email.

recovery_email.replace.comment: Button: add a different address in place of the current one.

recovery_email.send.comment: Main button: send the code to the typed address.

recovery_email.send_failed.text: We could not send the letter. Try again later.
recovery_email.send_failed.comment: The server failed to hand the letter over.

recovery_email.status.off.comment: Value of the Settings row when no address is added.

recovery_email.status.on.comment: Value of the Settings row when an address is added. The address itself is never shown.

recovery_email.title.comment: Title of the Settings row and screen.

recovery_email.totp_warning.text: You will also need a code from your authenticator app. If it is on the phone you lose, the email will not be enough.
recovery_email.totp_warning.comment: Shown on the recovery email screen when the account has an authenticator.

recovery_email.unavailable.text: Email codes are not available right now.
recovery_email.unavailable.comment: Mail is not set up on this server.

recovery_email.username_change.text: Changing your username turns your recovery email off. You can add it again afterwards.
recovery_email.username_change.comment: On the username screen, before a change, when the account has a recovery email.

recovery_phrase.check.acknowledge.text: I understand that without these words, another logged-in device or a passkey that restores keys, my chats cannot be brought back.
recovery_phrase.check.acknowledge.comment: Checkbox the person ticks before finishing. Without the words, another logged-in device or a passkey with restoring keys turned on, the chats cannot be recovered.

recovery_phrase.check.back.comment: Button back to the recovery phrase.

recovery_phrase.check.lede.text: Type words {positions} from what you wrote down.
recovery_phrase.check.lede.comment: Which words to type back; {positions} is a list of word numbers in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_many.text: Words {positions} do not match. Check your notes and try again.
recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_many.comment: Several typed words were wrong; {positions} is a list of numbers in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_one.text: Word {position} does not match. Check your notes and try again.
recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_one.comment: One typed word was wrong; {position} is its number in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.check.title.comment: Title of the step that checks the phrase was written down.

recovery_phrase.copy_failed.text: Could not copy. Write the words down instead.

recovery_phrase.error.incomplete.text: Enter all 12 words of your recovery phrase.
recovery_phrase.error.incomplete.comment: The recovery phrase fields were submitted empty.

recovery_phrase.fresh.acknowledge.text: I have written down these 12 words and understand that without them, another logged-in device or a passkey that restores keys, my chats cannot be brought back.
recovery_phrase.fresh.acknowledge.comment: Checkbox the person ticks before finishing. Without the words, another logged-in device or a passkey with restoring keys turned on, the chats cannot be recovered.

recovery_phrase.fresh.devices_signed_out.text: Your other devices were signed out. Add them again from Settings > Devices.
recovery_phrase.fresh.devices_signed_out.comment: Third sentence under the new recovery phrase after the account keys were reset (UX identity-recovery 15.4).

recovery_phrase.fresh.error.generic.comment: Finishing after the new phrase failed.

recovery_phrase.fresh.finishing.comment: Busy label while the reset of the account keys is finished.

recovery_phrase.fresh.lede.text: The account keys for {username} were reset. These 12 words bring the account back on a new device if you lose access again. Write them down in order and keep them somewhere safe.
recovery_phrase.fresh.lede.comment: After resetting the account keys; {username} is the account (@name, shown bold).

recovery_phrase.fresh.publish_error.text: Could not finish. Check your connection and try again.
recovery_phrase.fresh.publish_error.comment: Retrying the publishing of the new keys after a reset of the account keys failed because a server could not be reached (identity-recovery UX section 15.4).

recovery_phrase.fresh.publish_owed.text: Your account keys were reset, but Lakko could not finish publishing them. Until that is done, your contacts and your other devices cannot find the new keys, so the new words are not shown yet. Try again.
recovery_phrase.fresh.publish_owed.comment: Shown instead of the new recovery phrase when the account keys were reset but telling the directory and the account's device list about the new keys did not finish (for example the connection dropped). Try again repeats only that step (UX identity-recovery 15.4).

recovery_phrase.fresh.publish_refused.text: Could not finish publishing the new keys. Try again later.
recovery_phrase.fresh.publish_refused.comment: Retrying the publishing of the new keys after a reset of the account keys was refused by a server: the reset proof was not accepted, or the server is not set up for it.

recovery_phrase.fresh.safety_note.text: Your contacts keep their chats with you. Your safety number changes.
recovery_phrase.fresh.safety_note.comment: Consequence of resetting the account keys for the person's contacts.

recovery_phrase.fresh.sign_in_to_finish.text: Sign in again to finish publishing your new keys.
recovery_phrase.fresh.sign_in_to_finish.comment: Shown instead of the new recovery phrase when the reset is older than 30 days and its publish is still owed: the person signs in first, which changes nothing else (UX identity-recovery 15.4).

recovery_phrase.fresh.title.comment: Title of the screen that shows the new phrase after the account keys were reset.

recovery_phrase.guest.lede.text: Your account has no password. These 12 words bring it back on another device, or on this one after its data is cleared. Write them down in order and keep them somewhere safe.
recovery_phrase.guest.lede.comment: For an account created without a password (a guest from a call link). Shown in the browser and in the phone apps, so it says 'device', not 'browser'.

recovery_phrase.label.comment: Label of the recovery phrase grid and input.

recovery_phrase.save.anyone_with_words.text: Anyone who has these words can read your messages and act as you. Do not share them.
recovery_phrase.save.anyone_with_words.comment: Warning under the 12 words on the save-your-phrase screen.

recovery_phrase.save.lede.text: These 12 words bring your account back on a new device if you lose your password and your devices. Write them down in order and keep them somewhere safe.
recovery_phrase.save.lede.comment: Why the recovery phrase matters and what to do with it.

recovery_phrase.save.no_screenshot.text: Do not keep them as a screenshot or in a plain text file.
recovery_phrase.save.no_screenshot.comment: Warning under the recovery phrase. (A device that holds the keys can show the phrase again in Settings, so this no longer says it cannot be shown again.)

recovery_phrase.save.title.comment: Title of the screen that shows a new recovery phrase.

recovery_phrase.save.written.comment: Button to go on once the recovery phrase is written down.

recovery_phrase.step.comment: Progress through the recovery phrase screens.

recovery_phrase.word_label.comment: Accessibility label of one word slot; {position} is its number in the phrase, in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.word_placeholder.comment: Placeholder of one word slot; {position} is its number in the phrase, in Latin digits.

restore_identity.device_intro.text: A device that is still logged in shows a six-digit code; type it here. No camera needed; a QR code is there if you prefer.
restore_identity.device_intro.comment: Line on the restore-identity screen when Another device is chosen: the signed-in device shows a code that the person types here.

restore_identity.error.bad_saved_account.text: Something is wrong with the account saved on this device. Log out and log in again, or use your recovery phrase.
restore_identity.error.bad_saved_account.comment: The account saved on this device cannot be read, so restoring from another device cannot start.

restore_identity.error.generic.text: Could not restore your identity. Try again.
restore_identity.error.generic.comment: Restoring failed for a reason with no more specific message.

restore_identity.error.invalid_phrase.text: That is not a valid recovery phrase. Check each word and try again.
restore_identity.error.invalid_phrase.comment: The typed words are not a valid recovery phrase.

restore_identity.error.not_published.text: No published identity was found to verify the recovered identity. Try again, or restore from a device that still has your account.
restore_identity.error.not_published.comment: The account's identity could not be found to check against; refused for safety.

restore_identity.error.nothing.text: Nothing to restore. Log in first.
restore_identity.error.nothing.comment: The restore screen was reached without a sign-in.

restore_identity.error.phrase_mismatch.text: That recovery phrase doesn't match this account's identity. Check the phrase, or pair an existing device instead.
restore_identity.error.phrase_mismatch.comment: The typed phrase belongs to a different identity; it is refused for safety.

restore_identity.error.unreachable.text: Could not reach the directory to verify the recovered identity. Check your connection and try again.
restore_identity.error.unreachable.comment: The identity could not be checked because the server was unreachable.

restore_identity.from_passkey_no_keys.text: Your passkey logged you in. It does not carry your keys.
restore_identity.from_passkey_no_keys.comment: First line of the "Restore your keys" screen when the person arrived by a passkey that only signs in.

restore_identity.from_passkey_unusable.text: Your passkey logged you in, but the keys saved with it could not be used. Nothing was changed.
restore_identity.from_passkey_unusable.comment: First line of the "Restore your keys" screen when keys were stored for the passkey but did not open or did not match the account; refused for safety.

restore_identity.lede.text: You are logged in as {username} on a device that does not have this account's keys yet. Until it does, you cannot read or send messages here.
restore_identity.lede.comment: Why the keys are needed; {username} is the account (@name, shown bold).

restore_identity.log_out.comment: Button that signs out from the restore-identity screen.

restore_identity.lost.create.comment: Button that resets the account keys (a last resort): the account gets new keys and a new recovery phrase.

restore_identity.lost.error.phrase_not_s.text: The new recovery phrase could not be stored on this device. Nothing was changed.
restore_identity.lost.error.phrase_not_s.comment: Creating a new identity was refused before anything changed: the device could not store the new recovery phrase, so the old identity is still in place.

restore_identity.lost.sub.comment: Subtitle of the option for someone who has no other device, no passkey that restores keys and no recovery phrase; also the title of that screen.

restore_identity.lost.summary.comment: Collapsed section for someone who has no other device, no passkey that restores keys and no recovery phrase.

restore_identity.method.passkey.sub.text: If you turned on restoring keys for a passkey.
restore_identity.method.passkey.sub.comment: Subtitle of the passkey method on the "Restore your keys" screen. 'restoring keys' is the wording of the button settings.passkeys.keys.turn_on; no quotation marks.

restore_identity.not_you.comment: Text before the Log out link on the restore-identity screen.

restore_identity.phrase_intro.text: Type the 12 words in order. Lakko checks them against your account before continuing.
restore_identity.phrase_intro.comment: Line above the 12 word fields when restoring the identity on a new device.

restore_identity.reset.confirm_label.comment: Label of the typed confirmation before resetting the account keys. {word} is the word to type, RESET, the same Latin letters in every language.

restore_identity.reset.effect_contacts.text: Your contacts keep their chats with you. Your safety number changes.
restore_identity.reset.effect_contacts.comment: Consequence of resetting the account keys: the contacts. One bullet of the warning.

restore_identity.reset.effect_devices.text: Every other device of this account is signed out and removed. They lose their chats and contacts for this account.
restore_identity.reset.effect_devices.comment: Consequence of resetting the account keys: the other devices. One bullet of the warning.

restore_identity.reset.effect_messages.text: Messages sent before today cannot be read with the new keys.
restore_identity.reset.effect_messages.comment: Consequence of resetting the account keys: old messages. One bullet of the warning.

restore_identity.reset.effect_passkeys.text: Every passkey of this account is deleted. You can add passkeys again afterwards.
restore_identity.reset.effect_passkeys.comment: Consequence of resetting the account keys: the passkeys. One bullet of the warning.

restore_identity.reset.effect_password.text: Your password and your authenticator app keep working.
restore_identity.reset.effect_password.comment: What a reset of the account keys leaves untouched. One bullet of the warning.

restore_identity.reset.error.generic.text: Could not reset. Try again later.
restore_identity.reset.error.generic.comment: Resetting the account keys failed before anything changed: any other server refusal.

restore_identity.reset.error.offline.text: Could not reset. Check your connection and try again.
restore_identity.reset.error.offline.comment: Resetting the account keys failed before anything changed: offline.

restore_identity.reset.error.wrong_passw.text: Wrong password. Check it and try again.
restore_identity.reset.error.wrong_passw.comment: Under the password field of the Reset account keys screen when the password was wrong. Nothing was reset.

restore_identity.reset.lede.text: This gives the account new keys and a new 12-word recovery phrase. Only do this if you have lost your recovery phrase, every other device and every passkey that restores keys.
restore_identity.reset.lede.comment: First paragraph of the warning before resetting the account keys (ADR-0073, UX identity-recovery 15.1).

restore_identity.reset.password_help.text: Enter your password to reset the account keys.

restore_identity.reset.password_label.comment: Label of the password field on the Reset account keys screen, shown when the person did not sign in with the password in the last ten minutes.

restore_identity.reset.resetting.comment: Full-screen busy state after the tap on Reset account keys; it cannot be cancelled.

settings.account.danger_zone.footer.text: Log out keeps your data on this device. Forget this device removes it; you can only come back with another signed-in device, a passkey that restores keys, or your recovery phrase. Delete account erases the account on the server and wipes this device; this cannot be undone.
settings.account.danger_zone.footer.comment: Note under the Log out / Forget this device / Delete account rows in Settings. The three action names are the row labels, keep them recognisable.

settings.account.delete.blocked.text: The account keys were reset recently. The account cannot be deleted until {date}.
settings.account.delete.blocked.comment: Shown instead of deleting the account while the account can still be taken back after a key reset. {date} is a formatted date.

settings.account.delete.body.text: This erases your server-side identity — username, keys, recovery factors and backup — and signs you out everywhere. Your local messages are wiped from this device too. This cannot be undone.
settings.account.delete.body.comment: Confirmation dialog body; lists exactly what is erased.

settings.account.delete.confirm.comment: Row title, row button and destructive button of the confirmation dialog.

settings.account.delete.error.cancelled.text: Cancelled. Your account was not deleted.
settings.account.delete.error.cancelled.comment: The person dismissed the passkey prompt that confirms deleting the account; nothing was deleted.

settings.account.delete.error.generic.text: Could not delete your account. Try again.

settings.account.delete.sub.text: Permanently erases your account and everything in it, and wipes this device. This cannot be undone.

settings.account.delete.working.comment: Label of the Delete account button while the account is being deleted.

settings.account.forget_device.body.text: You'll lose the cached account on this browser. The way back is another device, a passkey that restores keys, or the 12-word recovery phrase you wrote down at signup.
settings.account.forget_device.body.comment: Confirmation dialog body: the one fact that decides whether to press the button.

settings.account.forget_device.body_devi.text: Everything on this device is removed and the device leaves your account. To use this account here again you will need another device, a passkey that restores keys, or your 12-word recovery phrase.
settings.account.forget_device.body_devi.comment: Body of the Forget this device confirmation in the phone apps (the web wording speaks of a browser). Names the three ways back: another device, a passkey that restores keys, the recovery phrase.

settings.account.forget_device.confirm.comment: Row button and destructive button of the confirmation dialog.

settings.account.forget_device.sub.text: Removes your account data from this browser. Your messages stay on your other devices; to come back here you will need another device, a passkey that restores keys, or your recovery phrase.
settings.account.forget_device.sub.comment: What forgetting this device removes and how to come back.

settings.account.lede.text: Your data, signing out, this device, and deleting your account.
settings.account.lede.comment: Line under the Account title in Settings.

settings.account.log_out.comment: Row title and button that signs out on this device.

settings.account.log_out.body.text: Your messages stay on this device. Log back in with your password or passkey.

settings.account.log_out.sub.comment: What logging out does and keeps.

settings.account.log_out.title.comment: Title of the Log out confirmation.

settings.anti_censorship.status.unavaila.comment: Line under the Unavailable anti-censorship state. The technical reason goes to the log only.

settings.anti_censorship.status.unconfig.comment: Anti-censorship state: this build of the app has no configuration for it.

settings.anti_censorship.title.comment: Settings row and screen title for hiding the app's connections from network blocking.

settings.passkeys.error.generic.comment: Fallback for any other passkey failure.

settings.passkeys.error.network.comment: The passkey request could not reach the server.

settings.passkeys.error.server_status.comment: Passkey request failed; {status} is an HTTP status code in Latin digits.

settings.passkeys.error.unsupported.text: This browser / device can't create passkeys right now.
settings.passkeys.error.unsupported.comment: The platform refused to create a passkey.

settings.passkeys.keys.turn_on.comment: Button on a passkey that only signs in; opens the screen that asks whether this passkey may restore the account's keys.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.body_on.comment: What turning it on means: the safety of the keys then also depends on the Apple, Google or password-manager account that syncs the passkey. Apple and Google are company names.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.cancelled.text: Cancelled. This passkey still only logs you in.
settings.passkeys.keys_choice.cancelled.comment: The person dismissed the passkey prompt while turning on restoring keys.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.done.text: This passkey now restores your keys.
settings.passkeys.keys_choice.done.comment: Confirmation after restoring keys was turned on for a passkey.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.error.othe.text: A different passkey answered. Try again and choose the passkey you are turning this on for.
settings.passkeys.keys_choice.error.othe.comment: The passkey prompt was answered by another passkey than the one being changed.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.error.phra.text: That recovery phrase does not belong to this account. Nothing was changed.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.later.text: You can change this later for each passkey.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.no_prf.text: This passkey can log you in, but on this device and passkey provider it cannot carry your keys. Keep your recovery phrase.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.phrase_nee.text: Type your recovery phrase to turn this on.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.signin_onl.comment: Button: keep this passkey for signing in only. Same weight as the other button; neither is the default.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.title.text: Let this passkey restore your keys?

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.turn_on.comment: Button: let this passkey restore the keys. Same weight as the other button; neither is the default.

settings.passkeys.keys_choice.unavailabl.text: Restoring keys with a passkey is not available on this server.
settings.passkeys.keys_choice.unavailabl.comment: The server has restoring keys with a passkey switched off.

settings.passkeys.label.restores_keys.comment: Label on a passkey in Settings: this passkey can also bring the account's keys to a new device.

settings.passkeys.label.signin_only.comment: Label on a passkey in Settings: this passkey signs in and cannot restore the account's keys.

settings.passkeys.lede_device.text: Log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock, or a security key, instead of your password. A passkey can also restore your keys on a new device if you turn that on. Your recovery phrase always works too.
settings.passkeys.lede_device.comment: Web and Android: text at the top of the Passkeys page. A passkey logs in, and restores the account's keys only when the person turned that on for it. settings.passkeys.name.label.comment: Accessibility label of the field that names a new passkey.

settings.passkeys.name.placeholder.text: Name this passkey (e.g. MacBook Touch ID)

settings.passkeys.remove.confirm.comment: Destructive button of the remove-passkey dialog when the passkey has no name.

settings.passkeys.remove.confirm_named.comment: Destructive button of the remove-passkey dialog; {name} is the passkey name, the accessible name at the point of no return.
