settings.recovery.phrase.confirm_show.comment: Line above 'Show recovery phrase' for an account that has no password to ask for.

settings.recovery.phrase.device_auth_fai.text: Could not confirm it is you. Try again.
settings.recovery.phrase.device_auth_fai.comment: iOS only. Shown on the Recovery page when the system check (Face ID, Touch ID or device passcode) in front of 'Show recovery phrase' did not succeed. The words stay hidden.

settings.recovery.phrase.device_auth_rea.comment: iOS only. The reason line in the system prompt (Face ID, Touch ID or device passcode) that confirms the person before the Recovery page shows the 12 words stored on this device. Short, no full stop; iOS shows it under its own heading.

settings.recovery.phrase.device_auth_una.text: Set a passcode on this device to show your recovery phrase here.
settings.recovery.phrase.device_auth_una.comment: iOS only. Shown on the Recovery page when 'Show recovery phrase' cannot run because the device has no passcode, so it cannot confirm who is holding it. The words stay hidden.

settings.recovery.phrase.error.generic.text: Could not check the password. Try again.
settings.recovery.phrase.error.generic.comment: Checking the password before showing the recovery phrase failed for a reason with no more specific message.

settings.recovery.phrase.hide.comment: Button that hides the recovery phrase again.

settings.recovery.phrase.not_saved_here.text: Not saved on this device. Keep your written copy safe.
settings.recovery.phrase.not_saved_here.comment: Recovery page: this device keeps no copy of the recovery phrase.

settings.recovery.phrase.password_prompt.text: Type your password to show your recovery phrase.
settings.recovery.phrase.password_prompt.comment: Line above the password field that guards 'Show recovery phrase'.

settings.recovery.phrase.saved_here.comment: Recovery page: this device keeps a copy of the recovery phrase in its secure storage.

settings.recovery.phrase.show.comment: Button on the Recovery page that shows the 12 words stored on this device, after a password check.

settings.recovery.phrase.sub.text: The 12 words you wrote down at signup restore your keys and contacts on a new device.
settings.recovery.phrase.sub.comment: Recovery page: what the recovery phrase restores.

settings.recovery.phrase.wrong_password.comment: The password typed to show the recovery phrase was wrong.

settings.recovery.sign_in_first.text: Sign in first to manage recovery.
settings.recovery.sign_in_first.comment: Recovery page opened without a ready session.

settings.recovery.title.comment: Title of the Recovery row in Security and of the Recovery page (authenticator).

settings.recovery.totp.already_enabled.text: An authenticator is already set up for this account. To replace it, sign in again with your recovery phrase or from another device first.
settings.recovery.totp.already_enabled.comment: The account already has an authenticator; the server refuses a silent swap.

settings.recovery.totp.done.text: Authenticator set up. A code from the app can now get you back into your account.

settings.recovery.totp.error.generic.text: Could not set up the authenticator. Try again.
settings.recovery.totp.error.generic.comment: Fallback for any other enrolment failure.

settings.recovery.totp.error.wrong.text: That code did not work. Wait for the next code in the app and try again.
settings.recovery.totp.error.wrong.comment: The enrolment code was wrong or expired.

settings.recovery.totp.key.comment: Line under the QR code; {key} is the secret key in a code font (rendered as an element), for typing it in by hand.

settings.recovery.totp.lede.text: A six-digit code from an authenticator app lets you sign in again if you lose your password.
settings.recovery.totp.lede.comment: Text under the Authenticator app heading.

settings.recovery.totp.scan.text: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key in by hand, then enter the six-digit code the app shows.
settings.recovery.totp.scan.comment: Instruction above the enrolment QR code.

settings.recovery.totp.title.comment: Card heading for the authenticator-app recovery factor.

settings.recovery.totp.unavailable.text: Authenticator setup is not available right now.
settings.recovery.totp.unavailable.comment: The server has authenticator recovery switched off.

settings.recovery.words.not_on_this_devi.text: Not available on this device: your recovery phrase is not saved here.
settings.recovery.words.not_on_this_devi.comment: Recovery page, three-words row, on a device that does not hold the recovery phrase.

settings.recovery.words.on_this_device.text: If you forget your password on this device, type three words of your recovery phrase to log in. There is nothing to set up.
settings.recovery.words.on_this_device.comment: Recovery page, three-words row, on a device that holds the recovery phrase.

settings.recovery.words.suspended.text: Paused on this device: the recovery phrase saved here did not log you in. It comes back after you restore this account here with your recovery phrase, a passkey or another device.
settings.recovery.words.suspended.comment: Recovery page, three-words row, when the phrase saved on this device was refused by the server at log in, so the three-word route is paused on this device until the account is restored here again.

settings.section.account.comment: Settings section: sign out, forget this device, delete account.

settings.section.appearance.comment: Settings section: theme and text size.

settings.section.danger_zone.comment: Settings section heading above Log out, Forget this device and Delete account.

settings.section.folders.comment: Settings section where the person creates, edits, orders and deletes chat folders; also its page title.

settings.section.media.comment: Settings section: camera, microphone and media options.

settings.section.network.comment: Settings section heading above the anti-censorship row.

settings.section.privacy.comment: Settings section that holds Who can find me. Also the link text in sentences that send the person there.

settings.security.attention_a11y.text: Security. A device was added to your account
settings.security.attention_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the Security entry in the Settings section list while it carries the exclamation-mark badge: a new device joined the person's own account and the person has not looked at it yet in Settings > Devices (which is inside Security).

settings.security.devices.sub.text: See, add and remove the devices on this account.
settings.security.devices.sub.comment: Subtitle of the Devices row in Settings > Security.

settings.security.lede.text: How you sign in, which devices can read your messages, and how you get back in.
settings.security.lede.comment: Line under the Security title in Settings.

settings.security.recovery.sub.text: Your recovery phrase and the other ways back into your account.
settings.security.recovery.sub.comment: Subtitle of the Recovery row in Settings > Security.

settings.security.safety_numbers.sub.text: Each contact has a safety number. Compare it in person or on a call; matching numbers mean nobody is in between. Find it in the contact's details.
settings.security.safety_numbers.sub.comment: Explains what a safety number is and how to compare it.

settings.security.safety_numbers.title.comment: Row title in Settings > Security explaining safety numbers.

tokens.action_allowance_used.text: You have used today's allowance for this. Try again tomorrow.
tokens.action_allowance_used.comment: An invite link, group link or channel name refused because the account's daily allowance for it is used up.

tokens.lookup_allowance_used.text: You have looked up a lot of people today. Try again tomorrow.
tokens.lookup_allowance_used.comment: Search for a username or channel refused because the account's daily allowance of lookups is used up.

tokens.search_allowance_used.text: Too many searches. Try again in a minute.
tokens.search_allowance_used.comment: The Discover channel search allowance is used up for now.

tokens.subscribe_allowance_used.text: You've subscribed to a lot of channels today. Try again tomorrow.
tokens.subscribe_allowance_used.comment: The account's daily allowance of channel subscriptions is used up.

update.available.message.text: A new version of Lakko is available.
update.available.message.comment: Dismissible banner at the top of the app when the signed release notice says a newer version is in the store.

update.available.opens_app_store_hint.comment: Screen-reader hint on the Update button of the update-available banner (iOS): what pressing the button does.

update.available.update.comment: Button on the update-available banner; opens the app's store page.

update.available.update_play_a11y.comment: Screen-reader label of the Update button on the update-available banner (Android): says the tap leaves the app for the Play Store.

username.a11y_hint.comment: Spoken by the screen reader for the reason under a username field. {message} is the reason, like 'At least 3 characters'.

username.change.title.comment: Title of the screen where a person changes their username, and label of the button that opens it.

username.claim.body.text: With a username and a password you can sign in on another device, add a recovery email, and people can find you.
username.claim.body.comment: Under the title of the choose-a-username screen.

username.claim.done.comment: Shown once after the username was saved; {username} includes the leading @.

username.claim.password_help.text: Choose a password for signing in. You have not had one until now.
username.claim.password_help.comment: Under the password field of the choose-a-username screen; the guest account was created without a password the person knows.

username.claim.save.comment: Main button of the choose-a-username screen.

username.claim.title.comment: Title of the screen where an account created without a username (a guest who joined a call by link) picks one, and label of the button that opens it.

username.error.bind_limited_later.text: You have changed your username too often. Try again later.
username.error.bind_limited_later.comment: Error when the server refuses a username change because the person changed it too often and the wait is over an hour or unknown.

username.error.bind_limited_minutes.text: You have changed your username too often. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
username.error.bind_limited_minutes.comment: Error when the server refuses a username change because the person changed it too often; {minutes} is the wait, rounded up.

username.error.empty.comment: Shown under the username field when it is empty.

username.error.invalid_characters.comment: Shown under the username field: usernames may only use a-z, 0-9 and underscore. Keep '_' as is.

username.error.too_long.text: At most {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
username.error.too_long.comment: Shown under the username field when it is too long; {count} is the maximum.

username.error.too_short.text: At least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
username.error.too_short.comment: Shown under the username field when it is too short; {count} is the minimum.

username.error.unknown.comment: Shown under the username field for any other refusal.

username.hint.shown_as.comment: Hint under a username field when the name is typed in another form (for example with capitals); {username} is how it will show, with @, like @alice.

who_can_find_me.applying_a11y.comment: Accessible name of the small spinner beside Who can find me while a change is being applied.

who_can_find_me.contacts_of_contacts.comment: Switch under Some people: people the person's contacts have added can find them.

who_can_find_me.contacts_of_contacts_hel.comment: Line under the Contacts of my contacts switch.

who_can_find_me.contacts_of_contacts_spr.text: Contacts of your contacts can find you once your contacts next open Lakko.
who_can_find_me.contacts_of_contacts_spr.comment: Line under Contacts of my contacts right after it is turned on: the change travels through the contacts' devices, so it is not in effect at once.

who_can_find_me.groups.text: Members of my groups and channels
who_can_find_me.groups.comment: Switch under Some people: people in the person's groups and channels can find them.

who_can_find_me.groups.all.comment: Choice under Members of my groups and channels: every group and channel counts.

who_can_find_me.groups.chosen.comment: Choice under Members of my groups and channels: only the groups and channels switched on in the list count. Also the title of that list.

who_can_find_me.groups_all_helper.text: Everyone in the groups and channels you're in.
who_can_find_me.groups_all_helper.comment: Line under Members of my groups and channels when All groups and channels is chosen.

who_can_find_me.groups_chosen_helper.text: Only the ones you choose ({chosen} of {total}).
who_can_find_me.groups_chosen_helper.comment: Line under Members of my groups and channels when only chosen ones count. {chosen} is how many are on, {total} how many groups and channels the person is in.

who_can_find_me.lede.text: Whoever can find you by username or name can ask to be your contact.
who_can_find_me.lede.comment: First sentence under Who can find me: what being findable allows.

who_can_find_me.lede_link.text: People with your invite link or QR code can always reach you.
who_can_find_me.lede_link.comment: Second sentence under Who can find me: the invite link works whatever is chosen.

who_can_find_me.list.channels.comment: Heading of the channels part of the Who can find me list.

who_can_find_me.list.choose.comment: iOS row under 'Only the ones I choose' in Settings > Privacy > Who can find me; opens the list of groups and channels to switch on one by one.

who_can_find_me.list.empty.text: You're not in any groups or channels yet.
who_can_find_me.list.empty.comment: Shown in the list of groups and channels for Who can find me when the person is in none.

who_can_find_me.list.groups.comment: Heading of the groups part of the Who can find me list.

who_can_find_me.list.no_match.comment: Shown in the Who can find me list when the search matches nothing.

who_can_find_me.list.search.comment: Placeholder and accessible name of the search field in the Who can find me list.

who_can_find_me.members_can_find_me.comment: Switch in group and channel info: the members of this group or channel can find the person by username or name.

who_can_find_me.members_excluded_notice.text: Now only the groups and channels you choose. Change in {privacy}.
who_can_find_me.members_excluded_notice.comment: Shown once after turning off Members can find me while all groups and channels counted: the setting switched to chosen ones. {privacy} is a link to Settings > Privacy and reads Privacy.

who_can_find_me.mode.everyone.comment: Option of Who can find me: anyone can find the person by username or name.

who_can_find_me.mode.everyone_helper.text: Anyone can find you by your username or name.
who_can_find_me.mode.everyone_helper.comment: Line under the Everyone option of Who can find me.

who_can_find_me.mode.nobody.comment: Option of Who can find me: no one can find the person by username or name.

who_can_find_me.mode.nobody_helper.text: Only people with your invite link or QR code can reach you.
who_can_find_me.mode.nobody_helper.comment: Line under the Nobody option of Who can find me.

who_can_find_me.mode.some.comment: Option of Who can find me: only the people picked by the two switches under it.

who_can_find_me.signup_after_create.text: It opens once your account is created.
who_can_find_me.signup_after_create.comment: Shown at signup in place of the Change link after the person tapped it: Settings > Privacy opens right after the account is created.

who_can_find_me.signup_change.comment: Link after the Who can find me line at signup that opens Settings > Privacy.

who_can_find_me.signup_line.text: Contacts of your contacts and people in your groups and channels can find you. You can change this in Settings > Privacy.
who_can_find_me.signup_line.comment: Line on the signup screen describing the default of Who can find me. A Change link follows.

who_can_find_me.status.failed.text: Couldn't update who can find you. Try again.
who_can_find_me.status.failed.comment: Status line on Who can find me when applying a change failed; a Retry button follows.

who_can_find_me.status.offline.text: Will apply when you're back online.
who_can_find_me.status.offline.comment: Status line on Who can find me when a change was made offline.

who_can_find_me.title.comment: Title of the Settings > Privacy screen that decides who can find the person by username or name and ask to be their contact.
